sections.title: The genealogy from Adam to Abraham.

verses.text: አዳም፥ ሴት፥ ሄኖስ፥
ቃይናን፥ መላልኤል፥ ያሬድ፥
ሄኖክ፥ ማቱሳላ፥ ላሜሕ፥
ኖኅ፥ ልጆቹም ሴም፥ ካም፥ ያፌት።
የያፌት ልጆች ጋሜር፥ ማጎግ፥ ማዳይ፥ ይሕያን፥ ኤልሳ፥ ቶቤል፥ ሞሳሕና ቲራም።
የጋሜርም ልጆች አስካናስ፥ ሪፋት፥ ቶርጋማ።
የይሕያ ልጆች ኤልሳ፥ ተርሴስ፥ ኬቲም፥ ሮድኢ።
የካምም ልጆች፤ ኩሽ፥ ምስራይም፥ ፉጥ፥ ከነዓን።
የኩሽም ልጆች፤ ሳባ፥ ኤውላጥ፥ ሳበታ፥ ሬግማን፥ ሱቦን። የሬግማንም ልጆች፤ ሴባ፥ ዳዳን።
ኩሽም ናምሩድን ወለደ፤ እርሱም በምድር ላይ አዳኝና ኀያል መሆንን ጀመረ።
ምሥራይም ሎዲአምን፥ ዐናኒምን፥ ሎቢንን፥ ንፍታሌምን፥
ጴጥሮሳኒኤምን፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን የወጡበትን ከሰሎንኤምን፥ ከፋቱሪምን ወለደ።
ከነዓን የበኵር ልጁን ሲዶንን፥ ኬጤዎንን፥
ኤያቡሴዎንን፥ አሞሬዎንን፥ ጌርጌሴዎንን፥
አዌዎንን፥ አረቄዎንን፥ ኤሴነዎንን፥
አራዴዎንን፥ ሰማሬዎንን፥ አማቲን ወለደ።
የሴምም ልጆች፤ አይላም፥ አሡር፥ አርፋክስድ፥ ሉድ፥ አራም፥ የአራምም ልጆች፤ ኡስ፥ ዑል፥ ጋቴር፥ ሞሳክ።
አርፋክስድም ቃይናንን ወለደ፤ ቃይናንም ሳላን ወለደ፤ ሳላም ኤቦርን ወለደ።
ለኤቦርም ሁለት ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ በዘመኑ ምድር ተከፋፍላለችና የአንደኛው ስም ፋሌቅ ተባለ፤ የወንድሙም ስም ዮቅጣን ነበረ፤
ዮቅጣንም ኤልሞዳድን፥ ሣሌፍን፥ ኤራሞትን፥ ያራሕን፥
Keduram, Ezel, Diklam,
Gemahhel, Elmehel, Saban,
Opher, Hewlan, Oram, Ukab, and they were all the children of Joktan.
And the sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Shalah, and Eber,
Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Abram, who is called Abraham.

sections.title: The generations of Ishmael.

verses.text: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
Their generations are as follows: The firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth; Kedar, Adbeel,
Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema;
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah; these are the sons of Ishmael.
And the children of Keturah, Abraham's concubine, whom she bore: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan.
And the sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abidah, and Eldah. All these were the children of Keturah.

sections.title: The genealogy of Esau.

verses.text: And Abraham begat Isaac. And the sons of Isaac were Esau and Jacob.
The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
The sons of Seir; Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
And the sons of Lotan; Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
The sons of Shobal; Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam; and the sons of Zibeon; Ajah and Anah.
The sons of Anah; Dishon, the daughter of Anah was Aholibamah; and the sons of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan; Uz and Aran.

sections.title: The Kings of Edom

verses.text: And among the children of Israel, there was yet no king, and the kings that reigned in Edom were these: Balak the son of Zippor; and the name of the city was Dinhabah.
And Balak died; and he was succeeded by Jobab the son of Zerah, who was of the city of Bozrah.
And Jobab died; and he was succeeded by Husham, who was of the land of Teman.
And Husham died; and he was succeeded by Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab; and the name of the city was Avith.
And Hadad died; and he was succeeded by Samlah of Masrekah.
And Samlah died; and he was succeeded by Shaul of Rehoboth by the river.
And Shaul died; and he was succeeded by Baal-hanan the son of Achbor.
And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died; and he was succeeded by Hadad; and the name of the city was Paal; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
And Hadad died; and these were the dukes of Edom: Duke Timnah, Duke Alvah, Duke Jetheth,
Duke Aholibamah, Duke Elah, Duke Pinon.
Kenaz was a chief, Teman was a chief, Mebsar was a chief,
Magdiel was a chief, Zareel was a chief; these were the chiefs of Edom.
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ስሞች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሮቤል፥ ስምዖን፥ ሌዊ፥ ይሁዳ፥ ይሳኮር፥ ዛብሎን፤
ዳን፥ ዮሴፍ፥ ብንያም፥ ንፍታሌም፥ ጋድ፥ አሴር።
የይሁዳ ልጆች፤ ዔር፥ አውናን፥ ሴሎም፤ እነዚህ ሦስቱ ከከነዓናዊቱ ሴት ከሴዋ ልጅ ተወለዱለት። የይሁዳም የበኵር ልጅ ዔር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነበረ፤ ገደለውም።
ምራቱም ትዕማር ፋሬስንና ዛራን ወለደችለት፤ የይሁዳም ልጆች ሁሉ አምስት ነበሩ።
የፋሬስ ልጆች፤ ኤስሮም፥ ያሙሔል።
የዛራም ልጆች፤ ዘምሪ፥ ኤታን፥ ኤማን፥ ካልኮል፥ ዳራ፤ ሁሉም አምስት ነበሩ።
የዘምሪም ልጅ ከርሚ ነው፤ የከርሚም ልጅ እስራኤልን ያስጨነቀ፥ እርሙን ሰርቆ የበደለ አካን ነበረ።
የኤታንም ልጅ አዛርያ ነበረ።
ለኤስሮም የተወለዱለት ልጆች፤ ኢያሬሄም፥ አራም፥ ካሌብ ነበሩ።
አራምም አሚናዳብን ወለደ፤ አሚናዳብም የይሁዳን ልጆች አለቃ ነአሶንን ወለደ፤
ነአሶንም ሰልሞንን ወለደ፤ ሰልሞን ቦዔዝን ወለደ፤
ቦዔዝም ኢዮቤድን ወለደ፤ ኢዮቤድም እሴይን ወለደ፤
እሴይም የበኵር ልጁን ኤልያብን፥ ሁለተኛውንም አሚናዳብን፥ ሦስተኛውንም ሣማን፥
አራተኛውንም ናትናኤልን፥ አምስተኛውንም ራዳይን፥
ስድስተኛውንም አሶንን፥ ሰባተኛውንም ዳዊትን ወለደ፤
እኅቶቻቸውም ሶርህያና አቢግያ ነበሩ። የሶርህያም ልጆች አቢሳ፥ ኢዮአብ፥ አሣሄል እኒህ ሦስቱ ነበሩ።
አቢግያም አሜሳይን ወለደች፤ የአሜሳይም አባት እስማኤላዊው ይትኤር ነበረ።
የኤስሮምም ልጅ ካሌብ ዐዙባ የምትባል ሚስት አገባ፥ ይሪዖትንም አገባ፤ ልጆችዋም ያሳር፥ ሶባብ፥ ኤርኖን ነበሩ።
ዐዙባም ሞተች፥ ካሌብም ኤፍራታን አገባ፤ እርስዋም ኦርን ወለደችለት።
ኦርም ኡሪን ወለደ፥ ኡሪም ባስልኤልን ወለደ።
ከዚያም በኋላ ኤስሮም ስድሳ ዓመት በሆነው ጊዜ ወደ አገባት ወደ ገለዓድ አባት ወደ ማኬር ልጅ ገባ፤ ሴጉብንም ወለደችለት።
ሴጉብም ኢያኤርን ወለደ፤ ለእርሱም በገለዓድ ምድር ሃያ ሦስት ከተሞች ነበሩት።
ኤስሮምም ጌሱርንና አራምን የኢያዔርን ከተሞች ከቄናትና ከመንደሮችዋ ጋር ስድሳውን ከተሞች ወሰደ። እነዚህ ሁሉ የገለዓድ አባት የማኪር ልጆች ከተሞች ነበሩ።
ኤስሮምም ከሞተ በኋላ ካሌብ ወደ ኤፍራታ መጣ። የኤስሮምም ሚስት አብያ የቴቁሔን አባት አስሖርን ወለደችለት።
የኤስሮምም የበኵር ልጁ የኢያሬምሄል ልጆች በኵሩ ራም፥ በአናን፥ አራን፥ አሶም፥ አኪያ ነበሩ።
ለኢያሬምሄልም አጥራ የተባለች ሌላ ሚስት ነበረችው፤ እርስዋም የአናም እናት ነበረች።
የኢያሬምሄል የበኵሩ የራም ልጆች ማኦስ፥ ኢያቢን ዔቄር ነበሩ።
የአናምም ልጆች ሸማይና ያዳይ ነበሩ። የሸማይም ልጆች ናዳብና አቢሱር ነበሩ።
የአቢሱርም ሚስት ስም አቢካኤል ነበረ፤ እርስዋም፥ አዛቡርንና ሞሊድን ወለደችለት።
የናዳብም ልጆች ሴሌድና አፋይም ነበሩ፤ ሴሌድም ልጆችን ሳይወልድ ሞተ።
የአፋይምም ልጅ ይሲ፥ የይሲም ልጅ ሶሳን፥ የሶሳንም ልጅ አሕላይ ነበረ። የአሕላይም ልጅ ይዳይ ነበረ።
የይዳይ ልጆች አክሲም፥ ዮቴርና ዮናታን ነበሩ፤ ዮቴርም ልጆችን ሳይወልድ ሞተ።
የዮናታንም ልጆች ፋሌትና አዛዝ ነበሩ፤ እነዚህም የኢያሬምሔል ልጆች ነበሩ።
ለሶሳንም ሴቶች ልጆች እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤ ለሶሳንም ኢዮሄል የተባለ ግብፃዊ አገልጋይ ነበረው።
ሶሳንም ለአገልጋዩ ለኢዮሄል ልጁን አጋባት፥ እርስዋም ያቲን ወለደችለት።
ያቲም ናታንን ወለደ፤ ናታንም ዛቤትን ወለደ፤
ዛቤትም አውፋልን ወለደ፤ አውፋልም ዖቤድን ወለደ፤
ዖቤድም ኢያሁን ወለደ፤ ኢያሁም አዛርያስን ወለደ፤
አዛርያስም ኬሌስን ወለደ፤ ኬሌስም ኤልዓሳን ወለደ፤
ኤልዓሳም ሲስማኤልን ወለደ፤ ሲስማኤልም ሱላምን ወለደ፤
ሱላምም ኢዮቆምን ወለደ፤ ኢዮቆምም ኤልሳማን ወለደ።
የኢያሬምሄል ወንድም የካሌብ ልጆች በኵር የዚፍ አባት ማሪስ ነው፤ የኬብሮንም አባት የማሪስ ልጆች ነበሩ።
የኬብሮንም ልጆች፤ ቆሬ፥ ተፋ፥ ሬቆምና፥ ሴማዓ ነበሩ።
ሴማዓም የኤርቃምን አባት ራኤምን ወለደ፤ ኤርቃምም ሰማኤምን ወለደ።
የሰማኤምም ልጅ ማዖን ነበረ፤ ማዖንም የቤት ሱር አባት ነበረ።
የካሌብም ዕቅብት ጌፋ አራንን፥ ሞሳን፥ ጋዜዝን ወለደች። አራንም ጊዚኢን ወለደ።
የያዳይም ልጆች፤ ሬጌም፥ ዮታም፥ ጌርሶም፥ ፋሌጥ፥ ጌፋና፥ ሰጋፍ ነበሩ።
የካሌብም ዕቅብት ማዕካ ሴብርንና ቲርሐናን ወለደች።
ደግሞም የምድሜናን አባት ስጋብን የመክቢናንና የጌባልን አባት ሳዑልን ወለደች፤ የካሌብም ሴት ልጅ አስካ ነበረች።
የካሌብም ልጆች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ የኤፍራታ የበኵሩ የኦር ልጅ የቀርያታርም አባት ሶባል ነበር፥
The father of Bethlehem is Selmon, and the father of the house of Gad is Ori.
And the father of Keriatharim is the son of Sobah, they were the children of Aré, Hatzé, and Amanit.
The clans of Keriatharim; the Jitrathites, the Pahathites, the Shumathites, the Misharites; from these came the Sorahathites and the Eshtaolites.
The sons of Selmon were Bethlehem, the Netophathites, the Ateroth of the house of Joab, the men of the Nethinim, and the Saraiites were also present.
And those who dwelt in Jabez were the families of the scribes; the Terahites, the Shumathites, and the Sukathites; these are the Kenites who came from the house of Rechab, the father of Hamath.
These are the sons born to David in Hebron: the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess.
The third, Absalom, the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah, the son of Haggith.
The fifth, Shephatiah, the son of Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah.
These six were born to him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months; and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.
These also were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathsheba the daughter of Ammiel.
Ibhar, Elishama, and Eliphelet.
Nogah, Nepheg, and Japhia.
Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine in all.
All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
And Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, was born; and his son was Abijah; and his son was Asa; and his son was Jehoshaphat.
His son was Jehoram, his son was Ahaziah, his son was Joash,
His son was Amaziah, his son was Azariah, his son was Joatham,
His son was Ahaz, his son was Hezekiah, his son was Manasseh,
His son was Amon, his son was Josiah.
And the sons of Josiah were Johanan the first, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
And the sons of Jehoiakim were Jeconiah, his son was Zedekiah.
And the sons of Jeconiah were Assir, Shealtiel,
Melchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
And the sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam, Hananiah, and their sister was Shelomith.
And the sons were Asubah, Ahel, Berachiah, Hasadiah, and five in total were they.
The sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and his son Jaazaniah. The sons of Rephaiah, the son of Arnah, and the son of Abdu, and the son of Shecaniah.
The son of Shecaniah was Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Joel, Berechiah, and Nehuiah, six in total.
The sons of Nehuiah were Elihoenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three in total.
The sons of Elihoenai were Adaiah, Eliashib, Peliah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, and Anani, seven in total.

sections.title: The lineage of Judah.

verses.text: The sons of Judah are Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
And Shobal begat Reaiah; and Reaiah begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the generations of the families of the Zorathites.
These are the sons of Etam: Izrahiah, Ishmaiah, and their sister Hazelelponi.
The father of Gedor is Penuel, and the father of Azmaveth is Aher; these are the fathers of the house of Bethlehem, the descendants of Ephrathah, the father of Hur.
And to Tehinnah, the father of Ashhur, were born two wives, Helah and Naarah.
And Naarah bore Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These are the sons of Naarah.
The sons of Helah are Zereth, Izhar, and Etnan.
And Koz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
And Jabez was more honorable than his brethren; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "Because I bore him with sorrow."

And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, "Oh that Thou wouldst bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that Thine hand might be with me, and that Thou wouldst keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me." And God granted him that which he requested.
And Shuham, the brother of Caleb, begat Makir, the father of Esthon.
And Esthon begat Beth-Rapha and Paseah; he was the brother of the Kenizzite, the father of Nahash of the city of Ahtinah; these are the men of Raphah.
And the sons of the Kenizzites were Gotonial and Serahiah. And Gotonial had no daughter.
And Menathem begat Gofran. And Serahiah begat Joab, the father of the Gerashites; and they were mighty men of valor.
The sons of Jephunneh were Caleb's sons, Eru, Elah, and Naam. And the son of Elah was Kenaz.
The sons of Jeialel were Zeph, Ziphah, Tiriah, and Asarel.
And the sons of Ezra were Jether, Morad, Gafar, and Jealon; and Jether begat Maron, Samai, and the father of Ishtimon, who was called Israel.

His wife was Ahijah, the father of Gedor, and Heber, the father of Sokoh, and the father of Zanoah, who was called Kuti'el. These were the descendants of Morad, the son of Pharaoh, of the children of Bithiah.
The wife of Hodiah was the sister of Neham, and they were the sons of Germeu, the father of Keila, and the central one was Esitmoah.
And the sons of Simeon were Amnon; and the sons of Anan were Rehon and Tilon; and the sons of Yistem were Zechariah, and the sons of Zechariah were many.
The sons of Judah, the sons of Shelah, were Er, the father of Lekah, and Ada, the father of Merisa, who were good craftsmen in the house of Asbeah.
Jehoiakim, the men of Kazib, Jehoash, who were known in Moab, Abdon, and Tekoa, were those who returned as a remnant.
These were the workers of the king who dwelt with the men of Netaim and Gadirah. They remained there securely in the kingdom.
The sons of Simeon were Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
His son was Shalem, his son was Mebsam, his son was Mashma.
The sons of Mashma were his son Hamuel, his son Sabad, his son Zakur, and his son Semai.
To Semai were six sons and six daughters; but his brothers had not many children, nor did all their family multiply like the children of Judah.
In Beersheba, in Shema, in Moladah, in Hazar-sual,
in Beelah, in Ezem, in Tolad;
in Betuel, in Hermah, in Shekelah.
In Bethmarcaboth, in Hazer-susim, in Beth-biri, in Sa'arayim they dwelt. Until the reign of David, these were their cities.
Their settlements were Etam, Ain, Remmon, Tokin, and Ashan, five cities;
All their settlements were around these cities as far as Baal. Their dwelling place and their territory were thus.
Mesobab, the son of Mlik, the son of Amisyas, was he;
Joel, the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asahiel, was he;
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshaiah, Azareel, Ishmael, and the sons of Naan;
The son of Zuph, the son of Alon, the son of Yidaiah, the son of Samari, the son of Shemaiah;
These were called by their names, leaders over their clans; and the houses of their fathers were established.
To their herdsmen they went to Gera, until they reached the east of Gai.
They found many exceedingly good pastures, and the land was wide and quiet, for there was peace before them; in former times they had dwelt there, they were of the children of Ham.

In their names, these are written, having come in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and they smote their idols and the inhabitants found therein; even unto this day they have completed their destruction; and there was a place for their kings to dwell, and they settled in their place.
And of the children of Simeon, five hundred men went to the mountain of Seir; and their leaders were Ishi, the son of Ashi, and Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel.
They also smote the remnant of the Amalekites that had escaped; and there they have dwelt unto this day.

sections.title: The lineage of Reuben.

verses.text: These are the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel. For he was the firstborn; but when he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel; and he was not counted as the firstborn.
Judah prevailed over his brothers, and from him came the leader; but the blessing was for Joseph.
The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
The sons of Joel; his son was Shemaiah, his son was Gog, his son was Shemaiah.
His son was Micah, his son was Recha, his son was Beal.
The son of the king of Assyria, Tiglath-Pileser, was Beera; he was the chief of the sons of Reuben.
And when their genealogies were recorded by their clans, the leaders were Joel and Zechariah.
Until the captivity of Nabon and the captivity of the Almewon, the son of Joel, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Ozaz, was Bela.
In the land of Gilead, their livestock were multiplied, and they dwelt from the east of the Euphrates River to the entrance of the wilderness.
In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the eastern region of Gilead.

sections.title: The tribe of Gad

verses.text: The children of Gad dwelt in the land of Bashan, even unto Salcah, in their habitations.
And in the chief were Joel, and the second was Shapham, and the scribe was Jaanai, and Shaphat also dwelt in Bashan.
The houses of their fathers were these: Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jakan, and Zia, and Obed; these were seven.
These were the sons of Buz, the son of Joda, the son of Ioi, the son of Michael, the son of Gilead, the son of Edai, the son of Uri, the son of Abihail.
And the houses of their fathers were the chief, the son of Guni, the son of Abdeel, and he was their brother.
And they dwelt in Gilead in the land of Bashan, and in their pastures, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, even unto their border.
All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

sections.title: The lineage of Gad and the lineage of Manasseh.

verses.text: The children of Reuben and Gad, the descendants of Manasseh, were equipped with valor, bearing shields and swords; they were skilled in warfare, those who knew how to fight, numbering forty-four thousand seven hundred.
They engaged in battle with the Agareans and with the Itureans, with the Naphishites and the Nodabites.

And in the time of their warfare, they cried out to the Lord, and they put their trust in Him, and He delivered them; and in their land, they were strengthened, and the Agareans and all who were with them were given into their hands.
From their flocks, there were fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep, two thousand oxen, and from among the people, one hundred thousand donkeys.
Their armies were from the Lord, and many people were slain; until the time of their captivity, they remained in their place.
The children of Manasseh, the descendants of the tribe, settled from Bashan to Baal-hermon and to Senir and to Mount Hermon; they were numerous.
The chiefs of their fathers were these: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jediael; they were mighty men of valor, renowned men, the chiefs of their fathers' houses.

They transgressed against the God of their fathers; and the Lord stirred up against them the spirit of Pul, king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser, king of Assyria; he carried them away, even the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah and Habor and Hara and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

And the God of Israel raised up the spirit of Pul, the king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser, the king of Assyria, and he carried away the children of Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah and Habor and Hara and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

sections.title: The lineage of Levi.

verses.text: የሌዊ ልጆች፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት ሜራሪ።
የቀዓትም ልጆች፤ እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል።
የእንበረምም ልጆች፤ አሮን፥ ሙሴ፥ ማርያም። የአሮንም ልጆች፤ ናዳብ፥ አብዩድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር።
አልዓዛር ፊንሐስን ወለደ፤ ፊንሐስም አቢሱን ወለደ፤
አቢሱም ቡቂን ወለደ፤ ቡቂም ኦዚን ወለደ፤
ኦዚም ዘራእያን ወለደ፤ ዘራእያም መራዮትን ወለደ፤
መራዮትም አማርያን ወለደ፤ አማርያም አኪጦብን ወለደ፤
አኪጦብም ሳዶቅን ወለደ፤ ሳዶቅም አኪማኦስን ወለደ፤
አኪማኦስም ዓዛርያን ወለደ፤ አዛርያም ዮሐናንን ወለደ፤
ዮሐናንም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤ እርሱም ሰሎሞን በኢየሩሳሌም በሠራው ቤት ካህን ነበረ፤
And Azariah begat Amariah; and Amariah begat Ahitub.
And Ahitub begat Ahijah; and Ahijah begat Ahimelech.
And Ahimelech begat Ahijah; and Ahijah begat Azariah.
And Azariah begat Seraiah; and Seraiah begat Jehoiada.
And Jehoiada, when he saw that Judah and Jerusalem had been delivered into the hand of their enemies, took courage and went forth.
The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
And the names of the sons of Gershon are these; Libni and Shimei.
And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Merari; Mahli, Mushi; these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
Of Gershon; his son Libni, his son Jahath, his son Zimmah;
His son Joakim, his son Adon, his son Zara, his son Jathray.
The sons of Jeconiah; his son Amminadab, his son Kure, his son Aser.
His son Helcana, his son Abisaph, his son Aser.
His son Teath, his son Uriel, his son Oziah, his son Saul.
The sons of Helcana; Amaseh, Achimoth.
His son Helcana; his son Sufei; his son Naheth;
His son Eliab; his son Jeremiah; his son Helcana; his son Samuel.
The sons of Samuel; the firstborn Joel, and the second Abijah.
The sons of Merari; Mahali, his son Libeni, his son Shimei, his son Uzza,
His son Samiah, his son Haggiah, his son Ahijah.
And David, when the Tabernacle was pitched, appointed the leaders of the singers in the house of the Lord.
And Solomon, until he finished the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, had them ministering before the sanctuary, singing in the morning; and they stood for their service according to their order.
These were the ministers and their sons; from the sons of the Kohathites was Heman, the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel;
the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliab, the son of Toah;
the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai;
the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Sophonias;
the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Korah;
the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
And his brother Asaph stood on his right hand; Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea;
the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Melchiah.
የኤትኒ ልጅ፥ የዛራ ልጅ፥ የዓዳያ ልጅ፤
የኤታን ልጅ፥ የዛማ ልጅ፥ የሰሜኢ ልጅ፤
የኢያኤት ልጅ፥ የጌድሶን ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ ነው።
በግራቸውም በኩል የሚቆሙ ወንድሞቻቸው የሜራሪ ልጆች ነበሩ፤ ኤታን የቄሳ ልጅ፥ የአብዲ ልጅ፥ የማሎክ ልጅ፤
የአሳቢ ልጅ፥ የአሜስያስ ልጅ፥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ፤
የአማሴ ልጅ፥ የባኒ ልጅ፥ የሴሜር ልጅ፤
የሞአሊ ልጅ፥ የሙሲ ልጅ፥ የሜራሪ ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ።
ወንድሞቻቸውም ሌዋውያን እንደ እየባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ሥራ አገልግሎት ሁሉ ተሰጡ።
አሮንና ልጆቹ ግን የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ ለቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ሥራ ሁሉ ስለ እስራኤልም ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ ይሠዉ ነበር፥ በዕጣኑም መሠዊያ ላይ ያጥኑ ነበር።
የአሮንም ልጆች ስሞች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ልጁ አልዓዛር፥ ልጁ ፊንሐስ፥ ልጁ አቢሱ፤
ልጁ ቡቂ፥ ልጁ ኦዚ፥ ልጁ ዘራእያ፤
ልጁ መራዮት፥ ልጁ አማርያ፥ ልጁ አኪጦብ፥
ልጁ ሳዶቅ፥ ልጁ አኪማኦስ።
ማደሪያዎቻቸውም በየሰፈራቸው በየዳርቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ለአሮን ልጆች ለቀዓት ወገኖች አንደኛው ዕጣ ነበረ።
ለእነርሱ በይሁዳ ሀገር ያለችውን ኬብሮንን፥ በእርስዋም ዙሪያ የነበረውን መሰማሪያ ሰጡ፤
የከተማዪቱን እርሻ ግን መንደሮችዋንም ለዮፎኒ ልጅ ለካሌብ ሰጡ።
ለአሮንም ልጆች የመማፀኛውን ከተሞች፥ ኬብሮንን፥ ልብናንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ሴልናንና መሰማሪያዋን፤ ኤስትሞዓንና መሰማሪያዋን ሰጡ።
የኢያቴርን ከተማና መሰማሪያዋን፥ ዳቤርንና መሰማሪያዋን፤
ዓሳንንና መሰማሪያዋን፥ ቤትሳሚስንና መሰማሪያዋን፤
ከብንያምም ነገድ ጌባንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ጋሌማትንና መሰማሪያዋን፥ ዓናቶትንና መሰማሪያዋን ሰጡ። ከተሞቻቸው ሁሉ በየወገናቸው ዐሥራ ሦስት ነበሩ።
And to the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were given ten cities in the land of Gilead.

And to the children of Gilead, according to their families, were given cities from the territory of Issachar, and from the territory of Asher, and from the territory of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, were given three cities.
And to the children of Merari, according to their families, were given cities from the territory of Reuben, and from the territory of Gad, and from the territory of Zebulun, twelve cities were given.
And the children of Israel gave cities to the Levites from their possessions, with their pasture lands.
And from the children of Judah, and from the children of Simeon, and from the children of Benjamin, these cities were given by name.
And from the children of Ephraim, there were cities that belonged to certain families.
In the mountainous region of Ephraim, they gave the cities of refuge, Shechem and its pasture lands, and also Gezer and its pasture lands;
And Jokmeam and its pasture lands, and Beth-horon and its pasture lands;
And Elon and its pasture lands, and Gath-rimmon and its pasture lands were given to them.
And from the territory of Manasseh, they gave the cities of Aner and its pasture lands, and Belam and its pasture lands, to the children of Machir.
For the children of Gad, from the tribe of Manasseh, there is Gilead and its suburbs, and the region of Bashan, and its suburbs;
From Issachar, there is Jezreel and its suburbs, and the region of Dabbasheth and its suburbs;
Ramoth and its suburbs, and Anem and its suburbs;
From Asher, there is Mishal and its suburbs, and Abdon and its suburbs;
Hukok and its suburbs, and Rehob and its suburbs;
From Naphtali, there is Kedesh in Galilee and its suburbs, and Hammon and its suburbs, and Kirjathaim and its suburbs were given;
To the rest of the Merarites, from Zebulun, there is Rimmon and its suburbs, and Tabor and its suburbs;
From Reuben, there is the region of Bozer, which is by Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, in the wilderness; and its suburbs, and Jaser and its suburbs;
Kedemoth and its suburbs, and Mephaath and its suburbs;
From Gad, there is Ramath in Gilead and its suburbs, and Mahanaim and its suburbs;
Heshbon and its fortress, and Eleazar and its fortress were given.
The sons of Issachar; Tola, Phuvah, Jashub, and Shimron; they were four.

The sons of Tola; Uzzi, Rephiah, Jeriel, the sons of Tola, were heads of their father's house; they were mighty men of valor in their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
The sons of Uzzi were Izrahiah; and the sons of Izrahiah were Michael, Abdi, Joel, and Ishiah; five were they, all chief men.

And with them, by their generations, according to their fathers' houses, were bands of soldiers for war, ready for battle; and there were many women and children among them, and their number was thirty-six thousand.
And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were mighty men of valor, reckoned in all their generations; they were eighty-seven thousand.
The sons of Benjamin; Bela, Becher, and Jediah; three were they.
The sons of Bela were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri; five were they, heads of their father's house; they were mighty men of valor, and their number was twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
The sons of Becher were Zemira, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jerimoth, Abijah, and Anathoth; all these were the sons of Becher.
And their number, according to the generations of their fathers' houses, was twenty thousand two hundred mighty men of valor.
And the son of Jediah was Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
እነዚህ ሁሉ የይዴኤል ልጆች ነበሩ፤ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ጭፍራ እየሆኑ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡ ጽኑዓን ኀያላን ሰዎች ዐሥራ ሰባት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።
ደግሞም ሳፊን፥ ሑፊም የዔር ልጆች፥ ሑሲም የአሔር ልጅ ነበረ።
የንፍታሌምም ልጆች፥ ያሕጽኤል፥ ጎኒ፥ ዬጽር፥ ሼሌም፥ እነዚህ አራቱ የባላ ልጆች ነበሩ።
የምናሴ ልጆች ሶሪያዪቱ ቁባቱ የወለደችለት አስርኤልና የገለዓድ አባት ማኪር ናቸው።
ማኪርም ከሑፊምና ከሳፊን ወገን ሚስት አገባ፤ የእኅትየዋም ስም መዓካ ነበረ፤ የሁለተኛውም ስም ሰለጰዓድ ነበረ፤ ለሰለጰዓድም ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት።
የማኪርም ሚስት መዓካ ልጅ ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ፋሬስ ብላ ጠራችው፤ የወንድሙም ስም ሱሮስ ነበረ፤ ልጆቹም ኡላምና ራቄም ነበሩ።
የኡላምም ልጅ ባዳን ነበረ፤ እነዚህ የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጆች ነበሩ።
እኅቱ መለኪት ኢሱድን፥ አቢዔዜርን፥ መሕላን ወለደች።
የሰሜራም ልጆች አሒያን፥ ሴኬም፥ ሌቅሔ፥ አኔዓም ነበሩ።
የኤፍሬም ልጆች፤ ሱቱላ፥ ልጁ ባሬድ፥ ልጁ ታሐት፥ ልጁ ኤልዓዳ፥ ልጁ ታክት፤
His sons were Zabadh, Shuthlah, Edar, and Elad; and the inhabitants of the land were the sons of the mighty, who were able to carry their burdens and descend, and they were slain.
Their father Ephraim had greatly mourned for many days; and his brothers came to comfort him.
And he went in unto his wife, and she conceived; and she bore him a son; and he said, "I have been in sorrow in my house," and he called his name Beriah.
And the name of his daughter was Sheerah; and she built the lower and upper Beth-horon, and Uzzen-sheerah was her son.
And the sons of the men were Rephaiah, Seraph, and Telah, and Tahan.
His son was Adan, and his son was Ahimehud, and his son was Eleasah.
His son was Newe, and his son was Iyas.

And their dwelling place and their habitation was Bethel and its villages, on the east side Naharim, and on the west side Gezer and its villages, and also Shechem and its villages, even unto Gaza and unto its villages.

In Manasseh's children were Dor and its villages, and Taanach and its villages, and Megiddo and its villages, and Dor and its villages; in these did Jacob, who is called Israel, settle the children of Joseph.
The children of Asher were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah; and their sister was Serah.
The sons of Beriah; Heber, and the father of the Beriites, was Melchiel.
And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shamer, and Hotham, and their sister's name was Shua.
And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, and Jehubbah, and Aram.
And the sons of his brother Elah were Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
And the sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah.
And Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shelsha, and Itran; and Heber.
The sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
The sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Riziah.

All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the captains. And their number, according to the genealogies of their generations, was twenty-six thousand men fit for war.

sections.title: The lineage of Benjamin

verses.text: ብንያምም በኵሩን ቤላን፥ ሁለተኛውንም አስቤልን፥ ሦስተኛውንም አሐራን፤
አራተኛውንም ኖሐን፥ አምስተኛውንም ራፋን ወለደ።
ለቤላም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ አዳር፥ ጌራ፥ አቤሁድ፤
አቤሱ፥ ናዕማን፥ አሖዋ፤
ጌራ፥ ሰፉፋም፥ ሑራም።
እነዚህ የኤሁድ ልጆች ናቸው፤ እነዚህ በጌባ የሚቀመጡ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ናቸው፤ ወደ መነሐትም ተማረኩ፤
ናዕማን፥ አኪያ፥ ጌራ፥ እነርሱም ተማረኩ። ዖዛንና አሂሑድን ወለደ።
ሰሐራይምም ሚስቶቹን ሑሴምንና በዕራን ከሰደደ በኋላ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ልጆችን ወለደ።
ከሚስቱ ከሖዲሽ ዮባብን፥ ዲብያን፥ ማሴን፥ ማልካምን፤
ኢያሱብን፥ ሻክያን፥ ሜርማን ወለደ። እነዚህም ልጆች የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።
And Abitub and Elphaal were born of Hushim.
And the sons of Elphaal were Obed, and Mishaam, and Ohon, and Lod, and they built their dwellings in Samer.
In Riah, they dwelt; and they were the leaders of the inhabitants of the city of Elon, who had been the ancestors of their fathers.
And their brethren were Sosiq and Yiremoth.
Zabadiah, Arad, Eder;
Michael, the son of Sephat, Joah, the sons of Beriah;
Zabadiah, Meshulam, Hezqi, Heber;
Yissemray, Yizliyah, Jobab;
The sons of Elphaal were Yakim, Zikri, and Zebdi;
Eliyenai, Tzelitai, Eliel;
ዓዳያ፥ ብራያ፥ ሲምራት፥ የሰሜኤ ልጆች፤
ይሰጳን፥ ዖቤድ፥ ኤሊኤል፤
ዓብዶን፥ ዝክሪ፥ ሐናን፤
ሐናንያ፥ አንበሪ፥ ኤላም፤ አናቶትያ፥
ይቲን፥ ይፍዴያ፥ ፋኑኤል፥ የሶሴቅ ልጆች፤
ሸምሸራይ፥ ሸሃሪያ፥ ጎቶልያ፤
ያሬሽያ፥ ኤልያስ፥ ዝክሪ፥ የይሮሐም ልጆች።
እነዚህ በትውልዶቻቸው አለቆች ነበሩ፤ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።
የገባዖን አባት በገባዖን ይኖር ነበር የሚስቱም ስም መዓካ ነበር፤
የበኵር ልጁ ዓብዶን፥ ሱር፥ ቂስ፥ በኣል፥ ኔር፥ ናዳብ፥
Gideon and his brother Zachariah,
And Meqelot also heard and gave birth; and they dwelt in Jerusalem with their brethren face to face.

sections.title: The lineage of King Saul.

verses.text: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Melchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
And the son of Jonathan was Meribaal; and Meribaal begat Micah.
And the sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
And Ahaz begat Jehoiada; and Jehoiada begat Ahitub, and Ahimelech, and Azmaveth; and Azmaveth begat Ahijah.
And Ahijah begat Ahitub; and his son was Ahijah; and his son was Eliezer; and his son was Eshel.
And to Eshel were six sons; and their names were these: Azriqah, Bekeryu, Ishmael, Searyah, Abdiu, and Hanun; all these were the sons of Eshel.
And the sons of his brother Eshel were: Ulam, the firstborn; and the second was Jeash; and the third was Eliphalet.
And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers; and they had many sons and grandsons, a hundred and fifty; all these were the sons of Benjamin.

And all Israel, because of their transgressions, were taken captive to Babylon; and they were numbered by their generations. Behold, they have been written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
In the cities of Israel and in their regions, the priests, the Levites, and the servants were established first.
The children of Judah and the children of Benjamin, the children of Ephraim and the children of Manasseh dwelt in Jerusalem.
From the children of Judah, the sons of Perez, the son of Amri, the son of Omri, the son of Amihud, Uthai also dwelt.
And from the Selonites, there were Asaiah and his sons.
From the sons of Zerah, Jehoial and his brothers, six hundred and seventy.
And from the children of Benjamin, the son of Hasenuah, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Meshullam, Seloh.
The son of Jeroham, Jeabna; the son of Mikri, the son of Ozi, Elah; the son of Benjamin, the son of Raguel, the son of Shephatiah, Meshullam.
And according to their generations, their brothers were nine hundred and fifty-six; all these men were heads of their fathers' houses.
Among the priests were Joadah, Joarib, and Jachin;
And the house of the Lord was overseen by Azariah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub;
The son of Melchiah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Jirah, Adiah; the son of Emer, the son of Mishalmoeth, the son of Meshullam, the son of Ahzariah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Mehasiah;
And their fathers were leaders, and their brethren were seven thousand three hundred sixty; for the service of the house of the Lord, they were mighty men of valor.
Of the Levites, from the children of Merari, were Shamiah, the son of Azbiah, the son of Abishua;
And in the quarters were Erec, Galal, the son of Asaph, the son of Zichri, the son of Methaniah; the son of Edothan, the son of Galal, the son of Samiah, Abdi;
And in the settlements of the Netophathites dwelt the children of Helkiah, the son of Asa, in the region of Rachia.
And there were also the sons of Shalom, Akub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brethren; and Shalom was the chief among them.
Even unto this day, they were in the king's gate, on the east side; for the Levites had their dwelling in the king's quarters.

The son of Korah, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Korah, was Shalom; and his brethren, the Korahites, were in the service, keeping the charge of the tabernacle; and they were to keep the entrance of the house of the Lord. Their fathers also kept the entrance of the tabernacle.
Before him was Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, their chief; and the Lord was with him.
The son of Mesulam, Zechariah, was the keeper of the threshold of the house of the Lord.

These were the chosen ones, two hundred and twelve in number, who were appointed as gatekeepers. They were counted in their villages according to their families. David and the prophet Samuel did not overlook their faithfulness, but they were established in their service.
They and their children were gatekeepers at the house of the Lord, at the thresholds of the dwelling.
They were stationed at the four corners, to the east, to the west, to the north, and to the south.
And their brethren, in their villages, would come in from time to time to be with them on the sabbath days.
These four mighty men were the overseers of the four gates. The Levites were stationed in the house of the Lord, in the chambers and in the storehouses.
They were those who were entrusted with the opening of the house of the Lord, and they were the ones who opened the doors each morning.
They would count the vessels and take them out, and some of them were stationed over the vessels of service.
Among them were some who were responsible for the offerings, for all the holy things in the sanctuary, for the fine flour, for the wine, for the oil, for the incense, and for the spices.
Among the sons of the priests, some of them prepared the incense and the showbread.
And the son of Korah, Matithiah the Levite, was a chief among the mighty men of the great priesthood, in the matter of the offerings that were made.
And every Sabbath, they prepared the showbread, and the sons of the Levites were upon their faces, offering incense.
And from among the Levites, the chief of their fathers were the singers, who were appointed for their weeks of service and offerings; their work was both by night and by day.
These were the chief of the houses of their fathers among the Levites, and they dwelt in Jerusalem.
The name of his wife was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom; and he dwelt in Gibeah.
And the firstborn son was Abdon, the second was Sir, the third was Kish, the fourth was Abiel, the fifth was Ner, and the sixth was Nadab.
The seventh was Gedur, and his brother was Zechariah; and Meqiloth also.
And Meqiloth begat Shimeah; and they dwelt in Jerusalem with their brethren.
And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Melchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
And the son of Jonathan was Meribaal; and Meribaal begat Micah.
The sons of Micham were Pithon, Melech, Tarah, and Ahaz;
And Ahaz begat Jehoiada; and Jehoiada begat Galimeth, Gazmoth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Maaziah.
Maaziah begat Ahanan; and his son was Rephaiah, and his son was Eliezer, and his son was Eshel;
And to Eshel were born six sons; and their names were these: Azriqah, Bokeru, Ishmael, Searyah, Abdiu, and Hanan; these were the sons of Eshel.

sections.title: And King Saul died.

verses.text: በዚያም ወራት ፍልስጥኤማውያን ከእስራኤል ጋር ተዋጉ፤ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ፥ ተወግተውም በጌላቡሄ ተራራ ላይ ወደቁ።
ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በእግር በእግራቸው ተከትለው አባረሩአቸው፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም የሳኦልን ልጆች ዮናታንንና አሚናዳብን ሜልኪሳንም ገደሉ።
ሰልፍም በሳኦል ላይ ጠነከረ። ቀስተኞችም አግኝተው ወጉት፤ ከቀስቶችም ኀይል የተነሣ ተጨነቀ።
ሳኦልም ጋሻ ጃግሬውን፥ “እነዚህ ቈላፋን መጥተው እንዳይዘብቱብኝ ሰይፍህን መዝዘህ ውጋኝ” አለው። ጋሻ ጃግሬው ግን እጅግ ፈርቶ ነበርና እንቢ አለ። ሳኦልም ሰይፉን ወስዶ በላዩ ወደቀ።
ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ሳኦል እንደ ሞተ ባየ ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በሰይፉ ላይ ወድቆ ሞተ።
ሳኦልና ሦስቱም ልጆቹ የቤቱም ሰዎች ሁሉ በዚያች ቀን በአንድ ላይ ሞቱ።
በሸለቆውም የነበሩት የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ እስራኤል እንደ ሸሹ፥ ሳኦልና ልጆቹም እንደ ሞቱ ባዩ ጊዜ ከተሞቻቸውን ለቅቀው ሸሹ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው ተቀመጡባቸው።
በነጋውም ፍልስጥኤማውያን የሞቱትን ለመግፈፍ በመጡ ጊዜ ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በጌላቡሄ ተራራ ላይ ወድቀው አገኙአቸው።
ሳኦልንም ገፈፉት፥ ራሱንም ቈርጠው መሣሪያውንም አንሥተው ለጣዖቶቻቸውና ለሕዝቡ የምሥራች ይወስዱ ዘንድ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ሀገር ዙሪያ ሰደዱ።
መሣሪያውንም በአምላኮቻቸው ቤት ውስጥ አኖሩ፤ ራሱንም በዳጎን ቤት ውስጥ አኖሩት፤
And all the men of Gilead heard of all that the Philistines had done to Saul and to Israel.

Then all the valiant men arose from Gilead and took the head of Saul and the heads of his sons, and they brought them to Jabesh; and they buried their bones under the great tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
Thus Saul died because of his transgression against the Lord, for he did not keep the word of the Lord, and also because he consulted a medium for guidance.
And the prophet Samuel returned; and the Lord did not answer him, neither by dreams nor by Urim nor by prophets; therefore he died; and he turned the kingdom to Jesse's son, to David.

sections.title: David reigned over Judah and Israel as a king.

verses.text: And all of Israel gathered together unto David at Hebron, and they said unto him, “Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh;

“In times past, while Saul was king over us, it was thou that led Israel out and brought them in; and the Lord thy God said unto thee, ‘Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over my people Israel.’”

And all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and King David made a covenant with them before the Lord in Hebron; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
And David and all the men of Israel went to Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and the Jebusites, who were the inhabitants of the land, were there.
And the inhabitants of Jebus said unto David, “Thou shalt not come hither;” but David took the stronghold of Zion, which is the city of David.
And David said, “Whoever smites the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, went up first and was made chief.
And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
And David built round about from Millo and inward; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
And David went on and grew great, and the Lord of hosts was with him.

sections.title: The Might of David

verses.text: ለዳዊትም የነበሩት ኀያላን አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ስለ እስራኤል እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ያነግሡት ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር በመንግሥቱ አጸኑት።
የዳዊትም ኀያላን ቍጥር ይህ ነበረ፤ የሠላሳው አለቃ የአኪማን ልጅ ኢያቡስቴ ነበረ፤ እርሱ ጦሩን አንሥቶ ሦስት መቶ ሰው በአንድ ጊዜ ገደለ።
ከእርሱም በኋላ በሦስቱ ኀያላን መካከል የነበረ የአሆሃዊው የዱዲ ልጅ አልዓዛር ነበረ።
እርሱ ከዳዊት ጋር በፋሶደሚን ነበረ፥ በዚያም ገብስ በሞላበት እርሻ ውስጥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ለሰልፍ ተሰብስበው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ።
በእርሻውም መካከል ቆመው ጠበቁት፥ ያችንም ቦታ አዳናት፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ገደላቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርም በታላቅ ማዳን አዳናቸው።
ከሠላሳውም አለቆች ሦስቱ ወርደው ዳዊት ወዳለበት ወደ ዓለቱ ወደ ዓዶላም ዋሻ መጡ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በኀያላን ሸለቆ ሰፍሮ ነበር።
በዚያም ጊዜ ዳዊት በምሽጉ ውስጥ ነበረ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በቤተ ልሔም ነበረ።
ዳዊትም፥ “በበሩ አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውኃ ማን ይሰጠኛል?” ብሎ ተመኘ።
እነዚህ ሦስቱ ኀያላን የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ሰፈር ሰንጥቀው ሄዱ፥ በበሩም አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውኃ ቀዱ፤ ይዘውም ለዳዊት አመጡለት። እርሱ ግን ሊጠጣ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን ለእግዚአብሔር አፍስሶ፦
“ይህን አደርግ ዘንድ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ለእኔ አይገባኝም፤ ሰውነታቸውንም ለሞት አሳልፈው አምጥተውታልና የእነዚህን ሰዎች ደም እጠጣለሁን?” አለ። ስለዚህም ዳዊት ይጠጣው ዘንድ አልወደደም። ሦስቱም ኀያላን ያደረጉት ይህ ነው።
And Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the three; he lifted his spear against three hundred men and killed them at one time; and among the three he was renowned.
And among the second rank, he was honored, and he was their captain; yet he did not reach unto the first three.

In Kebeshael, there was a mighty man who performed great deeds, a valiant man of Judah, who struck down two Moabites, as fierce as lions; and in the days of harvest, he also struck down a lion in the midst of a pit.

The height of the Egyptian was five cubits; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and killed him with his own spear.
This is what the son of Judah did in Naash; his name was renowned among the three mighty men.
Behold, he was more honored than the thirty; yet he did not attain unto the first three. And David set him over his guard.
Moreover, among those who were with him were these mighty men: Joab's brother Asahel, the son of Zeruiah; and Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem.
The Harorite, Shammoth; the Pelonite, Helez;
The Ithrite, Abiezer, the son of the Anathothite;
The Hushathite, Sibbecai; the Ahohite, Elai;
The Netophathite Meharai, the son of Netophathite Helid;
From the tribe of Benjamin, from Gibeah, the son of Ribai, Itai, the Benjamite;
The son of Gera, a man of Gibeah, Abiel the Berothite;
The Azmavethite Baromai, the Shalbonite Eliahba;
The son of Ezbon, of the Gizonites, Jonathan, the son of Shageh the Hararite;
The son of Shacar, of the Aroerites, Ahijah, the son of Ahitub;
The Machirite Opher, the Phelonites Ahijah;
The Carmelite Serai, the son of Ezbai, Narai;
And the brother of Nathan was Joel, the son of Haggai, Mibhar;
The Ammonite Sela, the son of Jashobeam, Joab's brother, Nahor the Berothite;
The son of Jethra, the son of Garib;
The son of Kethiah, the son of Uryas, the son of Ahla;
The son of Robel, the son of Ziza, Adina; he was the leader of the Robelites, and with him were thirty men;
The son of Mocha, Hanan, the mighty man, Jehoshaphat;
The son of Astoroth, Uzziah, the son of the Aroerites, Samana and Joel;
The son of Samri, Idai; and his brother was Tidai, the son of Jozahe;
The Maachathite, Eliel; and his son was Josiah, Elnaam, and the Moabite, Yitma;
Eliel, Obed, the Mizraite, Jeasiel.

sections.title: The descendants of Benjamin who followed David.

verses.text: በሴቅላቅም ከቂስ ልጅ ከሳኦል በተሸሸገ ጊዜ ወደ ዳዊት የመጡ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ በጦርነትም ባገዙት ኀያላን መካከል ነበሩ።
ቀስተኞችም ነበሩ፤ በቀኝና በግራም እጃቸው ድንጋይ ሊወነጭፉ፥ ፍላጻም ሊወረውሩ ይችሉ ነበር፤ ከብንያም ወገን የሳኦል ወንድሞች ነበሩ።
አለቃቸውም አኬዘር ነበረ፤ የጊብዓዊው የሰማዓ ልጅ ኢዮአስ፥ የዓዝሞት ልጆች ኢዮኤልና ፋሌጥ፥ በራኪያና ዓናቶታዊው ኢዩ፤
ገባዖናዊው ሰማያስ፥ እርሱ በሠላሳው መካከልና በሠላሳው ላይ ኀያል ሰው ነበረ፤ ኤርምያስ፥ ሕዝኤል፥ ዮሐናን፥ ገድሮታዊ ዮዛባት፤
ኤልዮዝ፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ በዓልያ፥ ሰማራያ፥ ሐሩፋዊው ሰፋጥያስ፤
ቆሬያውያን ሕልቃና፥ ኢሰያ፥ ዓዘርኤል፥ ዮዛር፥ ይሰከአም።
የግዶር ሰው የይሮሐም ልጆች ዮዔላ፥ ዝባድያ።

sections.title: And from Gad, those who followed David.

verses.text: And David was in the wilderness, and those who were with him were of the tribe of Gad, men who were mighty and valiant, men of war, who came to him; their faces were like the faces of lions, and they were swift as the roes upon the mountains.
The first was Azzar, the second was Abdaiah, the third was Eliab;
The fourth was Mesmenah, the fifth was Jeremiah;
The sixth was Etai, the seventh was Eliel;
The eighth was Johanan, the ninth was Elzabad;
The tenth was Jeremiah, the eleventh was Mechbenai.
These were the children of Gad, captains of the host; and the least of them was over a hundred, but the greatest was over a thousand.
In the first month, when the Jordan was full, overflowing all its banks, these were the ones who crossed over; they drove out all who dwelt in the lowlands, both to the east and to the west.

sections.title: And the descendants of Benjamin followed David.

verses.text: And David went to the places where he was, and the men of Benjamin and Judah came to assist David.

And David went forth to meet them, and said, “If ye come in peace to me, my heart shall be one with you; but if ye come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, let the God of our fathers look upon you and judge.”

And the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the thirty, and he said, “David, we are yours; O son of Jesse, we are with you; may God help you, for peace, peace be unto you, and to those who help you.” And David received them, and made them captains of the band.

sections.title: And from Manasseh, those who followed David.

verses.text: ዳዊትም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሳኦልን ሊወጋ በመጣ ጊዜ ከምናሴ ወገን ሰዎች ወደ ዳዊት ከዱ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያን አለቆች ግን፥ “በራሳችን ላይ ጉዳት አድርጎ ወደ ጌታው ወደ ሳኦል ይመለሳል” ሲሉ ተማክረው ሰድደውታልና እርሱ አልረዳቸውም።
ዳዊትም ወደ ሴቄላቅ ሲሄድ ከምናሴ ወገን የምናሴ ሻለቆች የነበሩ ዓድና፥ ዮዛባት፥ ይዲኤል፥ ሚካኤል፥ ዮዛባት፥ ኤሊሁና ጼልታይ ወደ እርሱ ከዱ።
ሁሉም ጽኑዓን ኀያላንና በሠራዊቱ ላይ አለቆች ነበሩና በአደጋ ጣዮች ላይ ዳዊትን አገዙት።
እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ሠራዊት ታላቅ ሠራዊት እስኪሆን ድረስ ዳዊትን ለመርዳት ዕለት ዕለት ይመጡ ነበር።

sections.title: The multitude of David's army.

verses.text: And as the word of the Lord, the number of the leaders of the army who came to David while he was in Hebron to return the kingdom of Saul to him is this.
Six thousand eight hundred of the children of Judah were armed and prepared for battle.
One thousand seven hundred of the children of Simeon were strong men for battle.
Four thousand six hundred were the children of Levi.
And the leader of the house of Aaron was Joada; and with him were three thousand seven hundred.
And with him was a valiant man, Goliath the son of his father, and there were twenty leaders from his house.
And the brothers of Saul, who were of the children of Benjamin, were three thousand; and the greater part of them kept the house of Saul.
And the children of Ephraim, who were valiant men and renowned in their fathers' houses, were twenty thousand eight hundred.
And those who came to David to help him in the stronghold of Manasseh were eighteen thousand men, each one according to his name.
And the men of Issachar, who understood the times and knew what Israel ought to do, were two hundred chiefs; and all their brethren were with them.
በጭፍራውም ውስጥ ዳዊትን ለመርዳት የወጡ የተዘጋጁ፥ መሣሪያም ሁሉ የያዙ የዛብሎን ሰዎች አምሳ ሺህ ነበሩ፤ ከእነርሱ አንድስ እንኳ ደካማ አልነበረም።
የንፍታሌምም አለቆች አንድ ሺህ ነበሩ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ጋሻና ጦር የሚይዙ ሠላሳ ሰባት ሺህ ነበሩ።
ለሰልፍም የተዘጋጁ የዳን ሰዎች ሃያ ስምንት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።
በጭፍራውም ውስጥ የሚወጡ፥ ለሰልፍም የተዘጋጁ የአሴር ሰዎች አርባ ሺህ ነበሩ።
በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ካሉ ከሮቤልና ከጋድ ሰዎች ከምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ የጦር መሣሪያንም ሁሉ ይዘው የመጡ መቶ ሃያ ሺህ ነበሩ።
እነዚህ ሁሉ ዳዊትን በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ያነግሡት ዘንድ አርበኞችና ሰልፈኞች እየሆኑ በፍጹም ልባቸው ወደ ኬብሮን መጡ፤ ደግሞም ከእስራኤል የቀሩት ሁሉ ዳዊትን ያነግሡት ዘንድ አንድ ልብ ነበሩ።
ወንድሞቻቸውም አዘጋጅተውላቸው ነበርና እየበሉና እየጠጡ በዚያ ከዳዊት ጋር ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጡ።
ደግሞም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ደስታ ሆኖአልና እስከ ይሳኮርና እስከ ዛብሎን እስከ ንፍታሌምም ድረስ ለእርሱ አቅራቢያ የነበሩ በአህያና በግመል በበቅሎና በበሬ ላይ እንጀራና ዱቄት የበለስ ጥፍጥፍና የዘቢብ ዘለላ የወይንም ጠጅ፥ ዘይትም በሬዎችንና በጎችንም፥ ፍየሎችንም በብዙ አድርገው ያመጡ ነበር።

sections.title: The Ark of the Covenant was brought to Jerusalem.

verses.text: And David was joined with the captains and the hundreds, and he was in accord with all the leaders.

And David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the Lord our God, let us send word to our brethren who remain in all the cities of Israel, and to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, that they may gather together to us.”
“Since the time of Saul, we have not sought the ark of our God,” they said.
And the matter was right in the eyes of all the people, and all the assembly of Israel said, “Let us do so.”
And David gathered all Israel from Shihor of Egypt to the entrance of Hamath, to bring up the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, the Lord who dwells between the cherubim, where His name is called.
And the ark of God was carried on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzzah and his brethren drove the cart.
And David and all Israel played music before God with all their might, with singing, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets before God.
And when they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
Then the anger of the Lord was aroused against Uzzah, and He struck him because he put his hand to the ark; and he died there before God.
And the Lord was displeased concerning the breach made by Uzzah, and unto this day that place is called “The Breach of Uzzah.”
On that day, David said, “How shall I bring the Ark of the Lord to me?” and he was afraid of the Lord.
And David did not bring the Ark of the Lord to himself, but he sent it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
And the Ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite for three months; and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom and all his household.

sections.title: The deeds which David performed in Jerusalem.

verses.text: And King Hiram of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and masons, and carpenters.
Concerning the people and concerning Israel, his kingdom was greatly exalted, and the Lord prepared David to be king over Israel.
And David took other wives in Jerusalem, and there were born to him more sons and daughters.
And these are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon;
Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet;
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia;
Elishama, Beeliada, Eliphelet.

sections.title: David's victory over the Philistines was ordained.

verses.text: And the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel; and the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it and went out to meet them.
And the Philistines came and gathered together at the valley of Rephaim.
And David said, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” And the Lord said, “Go up, for I will certainly deliver them into your hand.”

And David went to Baal-perazim, and there David struck down the Philistines. And David said, “The Lord has broken through my enemies before me like a breakthrough of water.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
And they left their idols there; and David said, “Burn them with fire.”
And the Philistines again gathered together at the valley of Rephaim.
And David again inquired of the Lord, and the Lord said, “You shall not go up; but circle around behind them and come upon them in front of the mulberry trees.
And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then you shall advance quickly, for then the Lord will go out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
And David did as the Lord commanded him; and he struck down the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
And the fame of David went out into all the lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.

sections.title: The preparation made for bringing forth the Ark of the Lord.

verses.text: And David made for himself houses in the city; and he prepared a place for the Ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
At that time, David said, “No one but the Levites may carry the Ark of God, for the Lord chose them to carry the Ark of the Lord and to minister to Him forever.”
And David gathered all Israel together to bring up the Ark of the Lord to the place which he had prepared for it, to Jerusalem.
And David gathered the sons of Aaron and the Levites.
Of the sons of Kohath; the leader was Uriel, and his brethren were one hundred and twenty.
Of the sons of Merari; the leader was Asaiah, and his brethren were two hundred and twenty.
Of the sons of Gershon; the leader was Joel, and his brethren were one hundred and thirty.
Of the sons of Elizaphan; the leader was Shemaiah, and his brethren were two hundred.
Of the sons of Hebron; the leader was Joel, and his brethren were seventy.
Of the sons of Uzziel; the leader was Amminadab, and his brethren were one hundred and twelve.
ዳዊትም ካህናቱን ሳዶቅንና አብያታርን፥ ሌዋውያንንም፥ ኡርኤልን፥ ዓሣያን፥ ኢዮኤልን፥ ሰማያን፥ ኤሊኤልን፥ አሚናዳብንም ጠርቶ፦
“እናንተ የሌዋውያን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ናችሁ፤ ወዳዘጋጀሁላት ስፍራ የእስራኤልን አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ታመጡ ዘንድ እናንተና ወንድሞቻችሁ ተቀደሱ።
በቀድሞ ሥራችን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር እርስ በርሳችን አላጠፋንም፤ በጦር አልፈለገንምና” አላቸው።
የእስራኤልንም አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ያመጡ ዘንድ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ ራሳቸውን አነጹ።
በመጽሐፍም እንደ ተጻፈ ሙሴ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ አዘዛቸው የሌዋውያን ልጆች የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት በትከሻቸው ላይ በመሎጊያዎቹ ተሸከሙ። መባእና ቍርባንም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበረ።
ዳዊትም በዜማ ዕቃ፥ በመሰንቆና በበገና፥ በጸናጽልም እንዲያዜሙ፥ ድምፃቸውንም በደስታ ከፍ እንዲያደርጉ መዘምራኑን “ወንድሞቻችሁን ሹሙ” ብሎ ለሌዋውያን አለቆች ተናገረ።
ሌዋውያኑም የኢዩኤልን ልጅ ኤማንን፥ ከወንድሞቹም የበራክያን ልጅ አሳፍን፥ ከወንድሞቻቸውም ከሜራሪ ልጆች የቂሳንን ልጅ ኢታንን፥
ከእነርሱም ጋር በሁለተኛው ተራ የሆኑትን ወንድሞቻቸውን ዘካርያስን፥ ቤንን፥ አዝኤልን፥ ስሜራሞትን፥ ኢያሄልን፥ ኡኒን፥ ኤልያብን፥ በናእያን፥ መዕሤያን፥ መታትያን፥ ኤልፋይን፥ ሜቄድያን፥ በረኞችንም አብዲዶምን፥ ኢያኤልንና ዖዝያስን አቆሙ።
መዘምራንም ኤማንና አሳፍ ኤታንም በናስ ጸናጽል ከፍ አድርገው ያሰሙ ነበር።
ዘካርያስ፥ አዝኤል፥ ሰሚራሞት፥ ኢያሔል፥ ዑኒ፥ ኤልያብ፥ መዕሤያ፥ በናያስ በመሰንቆ በልዑል ቃል ያዜሙ ነበር።
And Mattathias, Elphalai, Mekedah, Abdedon, Joel, and Uzzias, were eight who were to sing in the house of the Lord.
And the leader of the Levites, Kenaniah, was in charge of the singing; he was skillful in song.
And there were the gatekeepers at the tabernacle, Rakiah and Helkiah.

And the priests, Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethanel, Amassai, Zechariah, and Benaiah, were to stand before the ark of the Lord, ministering in their service. Abdidon and Jeiaiah were the gatekeepers of the ark of the Lord.
And David and all the elders of Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Abinadab with gladness.
And the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord were to offer seven bulls and seven rams as a sacrifice to the Lord in their time of service.

And David, along with all the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the singers, and the chief of the musicians, Kenaniah, wore fine linen robes; and David also wore a robe of fine linen.
Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the horn, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a joyful noise before the Lord.

And when the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, looked through a window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord; and she despised him in her heart.
And they entered bearing the Ark of the Lord; and David dwelt within the tabernacle that was pitched for it; and they offered before the Lord the burnt offerings and the offerings for peace.
And when David offered the burnt offerings and the offerings for peace, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
And for Israel, for the men and for the women, for each and every one, there was some bread, and some roasted meat, and some cakes of raisins.
To serve before the Lord and to worship the God of Israel, and to give thanks and to honor Him, they stood apart from the Levites.
And Asaph was the chief; and next to him were Zechariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, and Obed-Edom; and Asaph with the sound of cymbals played.
And the priests, in their divisions, were to stand continually before the Lord, according to the word of the Lord, to keep watch over the Ark of the Covenant.
And on that day, David commanded Asaph and his brethren to give thanks to the Lord before the people.

sections.title: Psalm of Praise

verses.text: This is the song of the children of Israel before the Ark of the Lord.
Sing unto the Lord; let them praise Him.
Glorify Him in His holy name;
Seek the Lord, and you shall be strengthened.
Remember the wondrous works He has done;
The servants are of the seed of Israel;
He is the Lord our God;
His covenant is forever;
That which He did for Abraham;
That it may be a decree for Jacob.
እንዲህም አለ፥ “ለአንተ የከነዓንን ምድር
ይህም የሆነው እነርሱ በቍጥር ጥቂቶች ሰዎች፥
ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ፥
ሰው ግፍ ያደርግባቸው ዘንድ አልፈቀደም፤
“የቀባኋቸውን አትንኩ፥
ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤
ክብሩን ለአሕዛብ፥
እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ፥ ምስጋናውም ብዙ ነውና፤
የአሕዛብ አማልክት ሁሉ ጣዖታት ናቸው፤
ክብርና ግርማ በፊቱ፥
Bring to the Lord, O ye families of the nations,
Bring glory that is due unto His name to the Lord;
The whole earth shall tremble before Him;
Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad;
The sea shall roar and be filled;
For He shall come to judge the earth;
Let us give thanks unto the Lord.
O God of our salvation, deliver us;
From everlasting to everlasting.

sections.title: The Order of Worship

verses.text: And thus, each day, as it was fitting for them, they served continually before the tabernacle, and they were gathered together with their brethren.
And Abidah and his six brothers, the sons of Edom, were appointed as gatekeepers; they were to be watchmen and guardians.
The priest Zadok and his brethren stood before the altar in the house of the Lord, at the place of the offering, as commanded by the Lord.

And to the children of Israel, they spoke, saying, "Let the servant Moses be as commanded, according to the law of the Lord, that the offerings which are to be made at the appointed times, morning and evening, be presented to the Lord."
For His mercy is everlasting; therefore, let us give thanks to the Lord, and let us remember the names of the faithful and of Edom, and let us stand with those who are written in their names.
And with them, the priests elevated their voices to sing praises and to offer songs to the Lord; the sons of Edom, however, were appointed as guardians.
And all the people went to their homes; and David returned to bless his house.

sections.title: The word that the prophet spoke to King David.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዳዊት በቤቱ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ ዳዊት ነቢዩ ናታንን፥ “እነሆ፥ ከዝግባ በተሠራ ቤት ተቀምጫለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ግን በመጋረጃዎች ውስጥ ተቀምጣለች” አለው።
ናታንም ዳዊትን፥ “እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና በልብህ ያለውን ሁሉ አድርግ” አለው።
በዚያም ሌሊት የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ናታን መጣ፤ እንዲህም አለው፦
“ሂድ፥ ለአገልጋዬ ለዳዊት ንገረው፦ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ በውስጡ እኖርበት ዘንድ ቤትን የምትሠራልኝ አንተ አይደለህም፤
ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በድንኳንና በማደሪያ ኖርሁ እንጂ በቤት ውስጥ አልኖርሁም።
ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር ባለፍሁበት ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ ስለ ምን ቤትን ከዝግባ እንጨት አልሠራችሁልኝም? ብዬ ሕዝቤን ይጠብቅ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ፈራጆች ላዘዝሁት ለአንዱ በውኑ ተናግሬአለሁን?
አሁንም አገልጋዬን ዳዊትን እንዲህ በለው፦ ሁሉን ቻይ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ አንተ መንጋውን ስትከተል በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ትሆን ዘንድ ከበግ ጥበቃ መርጬ ወሰድሁህ።
በሄድህበትም ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርሁ፥ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ ከፊትህ አጠፋሁ፤ በምድርም ላይ እንዳሉ እንደ ታላላቆች ስም ለአንተ ስምን አደረግሁ።
ለሕዝቤም ለእስራኤል ስፍራ አደርግለታለሁ፥ በዚያም እተክለዋለሁ፥ በስፍራውም ይቀመጣል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ አይናወጥም፤ የኀጢአትም ልጆች እንደ ቀድሞው አያስጨንቁትም፤
በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ ፈራጆችን ካስነሣሁበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ ጠላቶችህን ሁሉ አዋርዳቸዋለሁ፤ አንተንም ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ። እግዚአብሔር ደግሞ ቤትን ይሠራልሃል።
And to your fathers you shall go, when your days are fulfilled, and I shall raise up your seed after you, which shall proceed from your loins; and I shall establish his kingdom.
He shall build a house for My name, and I shall establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

I will be his father, and he shall be My son; if he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men; but My mercy shall not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I removed from before you.
And I will be faithful to My house, and his kingdom shall be established forever; his throne shall be established forever.
Thus all these words and all this vision did Nathan speak unto David.

sections.title: The Prayer of David, a Psalm of Thanksgiving.

verses.text: And King David came in; and he sat before the Lord and said, “O Lord God, who am I, that You have brought me this far? And what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
O God, this was but a small thing in Your sight; and You have spoken also of Your servant's house for a great while to come; and You have regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree.
You know Your servant, and what is the honor that has been bestowed upon David, Your servant?
According to Your heart, You have done all this great thing for me.
O Lord, there is none like You; and there is no God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

You, O Lord God, have made a great and revered name for Yourself, as it is this day, for You have redeemed Your people from Egypt, and there is no other people upon the earth like Your people, Israel.
You have made Your people Israel to be Your people forever; and You, O Lord, have become their God.
Now, therefore, O Lord, let the word that You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house be established forever; and do as You have said.
The Lord God, He is the God of Israel; let Your name be magnified forever, as the true God of Israel; and let the house of Your servant David be established before You.
O my God, since You have revealed to Your servant that You will build him a house, therefore Your servant has found it in his heart to pray before You.
Now, O Lord, Thou art God; and Thou hast spoken this good thing unto Thy servant.
Now, before Thee, may Thy servant's house be blessed to endure forever; for Thou, O Lord, hast blessed it; and it shall be a blessing unto all generations.

sections.title: David's victory over the Philistines.

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማውያንን መታ፤ አዋረዳቸውም፤ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም እጅ ጌትንና መንደሮችዋን ወሰደ።
ሞዓብንም መታ፤ ሞዓባውያንም ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፤ ግብርም አመጡለት።
ዳዊትም በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ የነበረውን ግዛቱን ለማጽናት በሄደ ጊዜ ሔማታዊውን የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን መታ።
ዳዊትም ከእርሱ አንድ ሺህ ሰረገሎች፥ ሰባት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች፥ ሃያ ሺህም እግረኞች ወሰደ፤ ዳዊትም ለመቶ ሰረገሎች የሚሆኑትን ብቻ አስቀርቶ የሰረገሎቹን ፈረሶች ቋንጃ ቈረጠ።
ከደማስቆም ሶርያውያን የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን ሊረዱ በመጡ ጊዜ ዳዊት ከሶርያውያን ሃያ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎችን ገደለ።
ዳዊትም በደማስቆ ሶርያ ጭፍሮችን አኖረ፤ ሶርያውያንም ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፤ ግብርም አመጡለት። እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊትን በሄደበት ሁሉ ያድነው ነበር።
ዳዊትም ለአድርአዛር አገልጋዮች የነበሩትን የወርቅ ማርዳዎች ወሰደ፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ይዞአቸው መጣ።
ከሚጢብሐትና ከተመረጡት ከአድርአዛር ከተሞች ዳዊት እጅግ ብዙ ናስ ወሰደ፤ ከዚህም ሰሎሞን የናሱን ኩሬና ዓምዶች የናሱንም ዕቃ ሠራ።
የኤማትም ንጉሥ ቶዑ ዳዊት የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን፥ ጭፍራውንም ሁሉ እንደ መታ ሰማ።
ቶዑም ከአድርአዛር ጋር ሁልጊዜ ይዋጋ ነበርና ዳዊት አድርአዛርን ወግቶ ስለ መታው ደኅንነቱን ይጠይቀውና ይመርቀው ዘንድ ልጁን አዶራምን ወደ ዳዊት ላከው፤ ከእርሱም ጋር የወርቅና የብር፥ የናስም ዕቃ ነበረ።
And King David consecrated these also to the Lord, from all the nations, from Edom and Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek, with silver and gold.
Moreover, Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
And in that valley, he made a great slaughter, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
And David ruled over all Israel; and he administered judgment and justice to all his people.
Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was the commander of the army; and Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was the recorder.
And Abiathar, the son of Ahimelech, and Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, were priests; and Susa was the scribe.
And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief rulers beside the king.

sections.title: David triumphed over the Ammonites and the Syrians as he had done before.

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ ናዖስ ሞተ፤ ልጁም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
ዳዊትም፥ “አባቱ ስላደረገልኝ ወረታ እኔ ለናዖስ ልጅ ለሐናን ቸርነት አደርጋለሁ” አለ። ዳዊትም አባቱ ስለ ሞተ ሊያጽናናው መልእክተኞችን ላከ፤ የዳዊትም አገልጋዮች ሊያጽናኑት ወደ ሐናን ወደ አሞን ልጆች ምድር መጡ።
የአሞን ልጆች አለቆች ግን ሐናንን፥ “ዳዊት የሚያጽናኑህን ወደ አንተ የላከ አባትህን በማክበር ነውን? አገልጋዮቹስ ከተማዪቱን ለመመርመርና ሀገሪቱንም ለመሰለል ወደ አንተ የመጡ አይደሉምን?” አሉት።
ሐናንም የዳዊትን አገልጋዮች ወስዶ የጢማቸውን ግማሽ አስላጫቸው፤ ልብሳቸውንም እስከ ወገባቸው ድረስ ለሁለት ቀድዶ ሰደዳቸው።
ሰዎችም ሄደው በሰዎቹ ላይ የተደረገውን ለዳዊት አስታወቁት። ሰዎቹም በብዙ አፍረዋልና ይቀበሏቸው ዘንድ ሰዎችን ላኩ፤ ንጉሡም፥ “ጢማችሁ እስኪያድግ ድረስ በኢያሪኮ ተቀመጡ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ተመለሱ” አለ።
የአሞንም ልጆች የዳዊት ሰዎች እንዳፈሩ ባዩ ጊዜ ሐናን የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ ከሶርያ መስጴጦምያ፥ ከሶርያ ሞዓካ፥ ከሱባም ሰረገሎችንና ፈረሰኞችን ይቀጥሩ ዘንድ አንድ ሺህ መክሊት ብር ላከ።
ሠላሳ ሁለትም ሺህ ሰረገሎችን የሞዓካን ንጉሥና ሕዝቡንም ቀጠሩ፤ መጥተውም በሜድባ ፊት ለፊት ሰፈሩ። የአሞንም ልጆች ከየከተሞቻቸው ተሰብስበው ወደ ሰልፍ መጡ።
ዳዊትም ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ኢዮአብንና የኀያላኑን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ላከ።
የአሞንም ልጆች ወጥተው በከተማዪቱ በር አጠገብ ተሰለፉ፤ የመጡትም ነገሥታት ለብቻቸው በሜዳው ላይ ሰፈሩ።
ኢዮአብም በፊቱና በኋላው ሰልፍ እንደ ከበበው ባየ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ጐልማሶችን መረጠ፤ እነርሱም ከሶርያውያን ጋር ተዋጉ።
የቀረውንም ሕዝብ ለወንድሙ ለአቢሳ ሰጠው፤ እነርሱም በአሞን ልጆች ላይ ተሰለፉ።
ኢዮአብም፥ “ሶርያውያን ቢበረቱብኝ ርዳኝ፤ የአሞንም ልጆች ቢበረቱብህ እረዳሃለሁ።
አይዞህ፥ በርታ፤ ስለ ሕዝባችንና ስለ አምላካችንም ከተሞች እንበርታ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በፊቱ ደስ ያሰኘውን ያድርግ” አለ።
ኢዮአብና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበረው ሕዝብ ከሶርያውያን ጋር ተዋጉ፤ እነርሱም ከፊታቸው ሸሹ።
የአሞንም ልጆች ሶርያውያን ከኢዮአብ ፊት እንደ ሸሹ ባዩ ጊዜ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሙ ከአቢሳ ፊት ሸሹ፤ ወደ ከተማዪቱም ገቡ። ኢዮአብም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።
ሶርያውያንም እስራኤል ድል እንዳደረጓቸው ባዩ ጊዜ መልእክተኞችን ልከው በወንዝ ማዶ የነበሩትን ሶርያውያን አስመጡ፤ የአድርአዛርም ሠራዊት አለቃ ሶፋክ በፊታቸው ነበረ።
ዳዊትም በተነገረው ጊዜ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፤ ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻግሮ መጣባቸው፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ዳዊትም ከሶርያውያን ጋር ተዋጋ፥ እነርሱም ከእርሱ ጋር ተዋጉ።
ሶርያውያንም ከዳዊት ፊት ሸሹ፤ ዳዊትም ከሶርያውያን ሰባት ሺህ ሰረገለኞችን፥ አርባ ሺህም እግረኞችን ገደለ፥ የሠራዊቱንም አለቃ ሶፋክን ገደለ።
የአድርአዛርም አገልጋዮች በእስራኤል ፊት እንደ ተሸነፉ ባዩ ጊዜ ከዳዊት ጋር ታረቁ፤ ተገዙለትም፤ ሶርያውያንም ከዚያ ወዲያ የአሞንን ልጆች ይረዱ ዘንድ እንቢ አሉ።

sections.title: David took four.

verses.text: And it came to pass, at the end of the year, when kings go forth to battle, that Joab led forth the host of the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and the weight of it was a talent of gold, with the precious stones; and it was set upon David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

And he brought out the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron. And thus did David unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.
And it came to pass after this, that there was war again with the Philistines at Gob; then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

And yet again there was a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
And it came to pass, when Israel was in distress, that Jonathan the son of Shimeah, David's brother, slew him.
These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

sections.title: David numbered the people of Israel.

verses.text: And again, Satan arose against Israel; and he incited David to number Israel.
And David said to Joab and to the leaders of the people, "Go, from Beersheba to Dan, and number Israel; and bring me word that I may know the number of the people."

But Joab said, "May the Lord add to His people a hundred times more than they are! But, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? Why then should my lord require this thing? Why should he be a cause of guilt in Israel?"
Nevertheless, the king's word prevailed against Joab. Therefore, Joab departed and went throughout all Israel and came to Jerusalem.

And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to David. And all Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew the sword; and from Judah there were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew the sword.
But the king's command was abhorrent to Joab, and he did not number Levi and Benjamin among them.
This matter was displeasing in the sight of God; therefore, He struck Israel.
And David said to God, "I have greatly sinned in doing this thing; but now, I pray, take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have done very foolishly."
And God spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying,
"Go and tell David, 'Thus says the Lord: I offer you three things; choose one of them for yourself, that I may do it to you.'"
ጋድም ወደ ዳዊት መጥቶ፥ “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ የምትወድደውን ምረጥ።
የሦስት ዓመት ራብ፥ ወይም ሦስት ወር የጠላቶችህ ሰይፍ እንዲያገኝህ ከጠላቶችህ መሰደድን፥ ወይም ሦስት ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ፥ ቸነፈርም በምድር ላይ መሆንን፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በእስራኤል ምድር ሁሉ ማጥፋትን ምረጥ፤ አሁንም ለላከኝ ምን እንደምመልስ አስረዳኝ” አለው።
ዳዊትም ጋድን፥ “እነዚህ ሦስት ነገሮች እጅግ ይከብዱኛል፥ እጅግም ተጨንቄአለሁ፤ አሁንም ምሕረቱ ብዙ ነውና በእግዚአብሔር እጅ መውደቅ ይሻለኛል፤ በሰው እጅ ግን አልውደቅ” አለው።
እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ላይ ቸነፈርን ሰደደ፤ ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሺህ ሰዎች ወደቁ።
እግዚአብሔርም ያጠፋት ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መልአክን ሰደደ፤ ሊያጠፋትም በቀረበ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር አይቶ ከመቅሠፍቱ ይቅር አለ፤ የሚያጠፋውንም መልአክ፥ “በቃህ፤ አሁን እጅህን መልስ” አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።
ዳዊትም ዐይኖቹን አነሣ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በምድርና በሰማይ መካከል ቆሞ፥ የተመዘዘም ሰይፍ በእጁ ሆኖ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተዘርግቶ አየ። ዳዊትና ሽማግሌዎቹም ማቅ ለብሰው በግንባራቸው ተደፉ።
ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔርን፥ “ሕዝቡ ይቈጠር ዘንድ ያዘዝሁ እኔ አይደለሁምን? የበደልሁና ክፉ የሠራሁ እኔ ነኝ፤ እነዚህ በጎች ግን ምን አድርገዋል? አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እጅህ በእኔና በአባቴ ቤት ላይ ትሁን፤ ነገር ግን አቤቱ በሕዝብህ ላይ ለጥፋት አትሁን” አለው።
የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ዳዊት ወጥቶ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ይሠራ ዘንድ ለዳዊት እንዲነግረው ጋድን አዘዘው።
ዳዊትም በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንደ ተናገረው እንደ ጋድ ነገር ወጣ።
ኦርናም ዘወር ብሎ ንጉሡ ዳዊትን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ተሸሽገው የነበሩ አራቱን ብላቴኖቹን አየ። ኦርናም ስንዴ ያበራይ ነበር።
And David came to Ornan; and Ornan came out from his threshing floor and received David. And he bowed down to the ground.

And David said to Ornan, “Grant me this place of the threshing floor, that I may build thereon an altar unto the Lord; for the full price shall I give thee; that the plague may be stayed from the people.”

And Ornan said to David, “Take it to thyself; and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes; behold, I give thee the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.”
And the king said to David, “Nay, but I will surely buy it for the full price; for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.”
And David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword in his sheath.
At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he offered sacrifices there.
And Moses made a tabernacle for the Lord in the wilderness, and the altar for the burnt offerings was at that time in Gibeon, at the high place.
But David was afraid of the angel of the Lord, and could not go to inquire of the Lord; therefore he went not.

sections.title: Preparation for the construction of the temple.

verses.text: ዳዊትም፥ “ይህ የአምላኬ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ነው፤ ይህም ለእስራኤል ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነው መሠዊያ ነው” አለ።
ዳዊትም በእስራኤል ምድር የነበሩትን መጻተኞች ይሰበስቡ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ለመሥራት የሚወቀሩትን ድንጋዮች ይወቅሩ ዘንድ ጠራቢዎችን አኖረ።
ዳዊትም ለበሮቹ ሳንቃ ለሚሆኑ ለምስማርና ለመጠረቂያ ብዙ ብረት፥ ከብዛቱም የተነሣ የማይመዘን ናስ አዘጋጀ።
ሲዶናውያንና የጢሮስ ሰዎችም ብዙ የዝግባ እንጨት ለዳዊት ያመጡ ነበርና ቍጥር የሌላቸውን የዝግባ እንጨቶች አዘጋጀ።
ዳዊትም፥ “ልጄ ሰሎሞን ታናሽና ለጋ ብላቴና ነው፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚሠራው ቤት እጅግ ማለፊያና በሀገሩ ሁሉ ስሙና ክብሩ እንዲጠራ ይሆን ዘንድ ይገባል፤ ስለዚህ አዘጋጅለታለሁ” አለ። ዳዊትም ሳይሞት አስቀድሞ ብዙ አዘጋጀ።
ልጁንም ሰሎሞንን ጠርቶ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ አዘዘው።
ዳዊትም ሰሎሞንን እንዲህ አለው፥ “ልጄ ሆይ፥ እኔ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት እሠራ ዘንድ በልቤ አስቤ ነበር።
ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እኔ መጣ፦ እጅግ ብዙ ደም አፍስሰሃል፤ ታላቅም ሰልፍ አድርገሃል፤ በፊቴም በምድር ላይ ብዙ ደም አፍስሰሃልና ለስሜ ቤት አትሠራም።
እነሆ፥ ልጅ ይወለድልሃል፤ የዕረፍት ሰውም ይሆናል፤ በዙሪያውም ካሉ ከጠላቶቹ ሁሉ አሳርፈዋለሁ፤ ስሙ ሰሎሞን ይባላልና፥ በዘመኑም ሰላምንና ጸጥታን ለእስራኤል እሰጣለሁ።
እርሱ ለስሜ ቤት ይሠራል፤ ልጅም ይሆነኛል፤ እኔም አባት እሆነዋለሁ፤ የመንግሥቱንም ዙፋን በእስራኤል ላይ ለዘለዓለም አጸናለሁ።
Now, my son, may the Lord be with you; and may He fulfill His word concerning you, as He has spoken, regarding the work of the house of your God, the Lord.
Only keep and observe the law of your God, the Lord, that He may give you wisdom and understanding; and may He establish your kingdom over Israel.

The Lord commanded Moses concerning Israel, that you should keep and observe the statutes and judgments; and if you take heed, then He will establish you; do not be dismayed, do not fear, do not be disheartened.

Now, behold, in my poverty, I have prepared for the house of the Lord one hundred thousand talents of gold and one million talents of silver, and much bronze and iron without weight; I have also prepared for the house of the Lord abundant timber and stones; you, my son, add to these.
You also shall add many laborers, stonecutters and woodworkers, and skilled men for every manner of work.
With no limit in gold and silver, in bronze and iron, arise and work; and may the Lord be with you.”
And David also commanded his son Solomon, saying to all the leaders of Israel, thus he charged them:

“Is not the Lord your God with you? And has He not given you rest on every side? For He has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land is subdued before the Lord and before His people.

Now seek the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul; and arise and build the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the name of the Lord.”
ዳዊትም በሸመገለ ጊዜ፥ ዕድሜንም በጠገበ ጊዜ ልጁን ሰሎሞንን በእርሱ ፋንታ በእስራኤል ላይ አነገሠው።
የእስራኤልንም አለቆች ሁሉ፥ ካህናቱንም፥ ሌዋውያኑንም ሰበሰበ።
ሌዋውያንም ከሠላሳ ዓመት ዕድሜ ጀምሮ ወደ ላይ ተቈጠሩ፤ ቍጥራቸውም በእያንዳንዱ ነፍስ ወከፍ ሲቈጠሩ ሠላሳ ስምንት ሺህ ነበረ።
ከእነዚህም ውስጥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሥራ የሚያሠሩት ሃያ አራት ሺህ ነበሩ፤ ስድስቱ ሺህም ጻፎችና ፈራጆች ነበሩ።
አራቱ ሺህም በረኞች ነበሩ፤ አራቱ ሺህም ለምስጋና በተሠሩት በዜማ ዕቃዎች እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ነበር።
ዳዊትም እንደ ሌዊ ልጆች እንደ ጌድሶንና እንደ ቀዓት እንደ ሜራሪም በየሰሞናቸው መደባቸው።
ከጌድሶናውያን ለአዳንና ሰሜኢ ነበሩ።
የለአዳን ልጆች አለቃው አድሔኤል፥ ዜቶም፥ ዮሔል ሦስት ነበሩ።
የሰሜኢ ልጆች ሰሎሚት፥ ሐዝኤል፥ ሐራን ሦስት ነበሩ። እነዚህ የለያአዳን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።
የሰሜኢ ልጆች ኤኢት፥ ዚዛ፥ ኢያአስ፥ በሪዓ ነበሩ። እነዚህ አራቱ የሰሜኢ ልጆች ነበሩ።
አለቃው ኤኢት ነበረ፤ ሁለተኛው ዚዛ ነበረ፤ ኢያአስና በሪዓ ግን ብዙ ልጆች አልነበሩአቸውም፤ ስለዚህ እንደ አንድ አባት ቤት ሆነው ተቈጠሩ።
የቀዓት ልጆች እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፦ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል አራት ነበሩ።
የእንበረም ልጆች አሮንና ሙሴ ነበሩ፤ አሮንም ለቅድስተ ቅዱሳን የተቀደሰ ይሆን ዘንድ ተመረጠ፤ እርሱና ልጆቹ ለዘለዓለም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያጥኑና ያገለግሉ ነበር፤ በስሙም ለዘለዓለም ይባርኩ ነበር።
የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ሙሴና ልጆቹ በሌዊ ነገድ ተቈጠሩ።
የሙሴ ልጆችም ጌርሳምና አልዓዛር ነበሩ።
የጌርሳም ልጆች አለቃ ሱባኤል ነበረ።
የአልዓዛርም ልጆች አለቃ ረዓብያ ነበረ፤ አልዓዛርም ሌሎች ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤ የረዓብያ ልጆች እጅግ ብዙ ነበሩ።
የይስዓር ልጆች አለቃው ሰሎሚት ነበረ።
የኬብሮን ልጆች አለቃው ኢያኤርያ፥ ሁለተኛው አማርያ፥ ሦስተኛው ኢያዝሔል፥ አራተኛው ኢያቄምያስ ነበሩ።
የዑዝኤል ልጆች አለቃው ሚካ፥ ሁለተኛው ይስያ ነበሩ።
The sons of Merari were Muali and Hamoshi. The sons of Muali were Eleazar and Kish.
And Eleazar died, having no sons, but only daughters; and his brethren, the sons of Kish, took them.
The sons of Hamoshi were three: Muali, Ader, and Iahirimoth.
They served in the house of the Lord from twenty-five years old and upward, each according to his name, and they were counted by the heads of their fathers' houses, these were the Levites.
And David said, "The Lord God of Israel has given rest to His people; He will dwell in Jerusalem forever."
And the Levites shall no longer carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings for service."
And at the end of the command of David, they were counted from twenty-five years old and upward, and those above that age were counted among the sons of Levi.

To serve in the house of the Lord, at their gates and within their chambers, to cleanse all the holy things, and to perform the service of the house of the Lord, under the hands of the sons of Aaron, their brethren.

Moreover, whether it be a fine flour offering, or a meat offering, or a drink offering, or whatever it may be, they were to serve in all matters of the holy things, according to the proper measure and in every respect.
Morning and evening they stood to bless the Lord and to praise Him;

In every Sabbath, in every appointed time, and in every feast, according to the ordinance, the number of offerings that are to be presented before the Lord shall be continually for the Lord, all the sacrifices that are to be made.
And for the service of the house of the Lord, the ordinance of the witness was to safeguard the order of the sons of Aaron, their brethren.

sections.title: The portion of the service of the priests.

verses.text: These are the sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, having no children; and the sons of Aaron, Eleazar and Ithamar, ministered as priests.
And David, from the sons of Eleazar, appointed Ahitub, and from the sons of Ithamar, he appointed Ahimelech, according to their offices and as their fathers had done in their houses.

And the sons of Eleazar were leaders over the sons of Ithamar, and thus they were divided: there were sixteen leaders from the house of Eleazar, and there were eight leaders from the house of Ithamar.
Among the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar were the priests and the leaders of the house of God, and they were thus appointed by lot.

And from among the Levites, the son of Nathan, the scribe Samaias, wrote before the king and the leaders, before the priest Zadok and Abiathar’s son Ahimelech, and before the priests and the Levite fathers; he wrote for them: one for the house of Eleazar, and one for the house of Ithamar.
The first lot went to Jehoiarib; the second lot went to Jedaiah;
The third lot went to Harim; the fourth lot went to Seorim;
The fifth lot went to Malchijah; the sixth lot went to Meijamin;
The seventh lot went to Hakkoz; the eighth lot went to Abijah;
The seventh unto Iyasus, the tenth unto Sekeni,
The first tenth unto Eliashib, the second tenth unto Eliakim,
The third tenth unto Ophaiah, the fourth tenth unto Esabiah,
The fifth tenth unto Belgaiah, the sixth tenth unto Emer,
The seventh tenth unto Iazeiah, the eighth tenth unto Apheis,
The ninth tenth unto Pethahiah, the twentieth unto Hizkiel,
The first twentieth unto Akeno, the second twentieth unto Gamuhiel,
The third twentieth unto Delaiah, the fourth twentieth unto Muazi.

As the Lord God of Israel commanded, according to the ordinance given by their fathers in the hand of Aaron, they shall enter into the house of the Lord, and according to their service, their number was thus.

sections.title: The List of the Names of the Levites

verses.text: ከቀሩትም የሌዊ ልጆች፤ ከእንበረም ልጆች ስባሄል፤ ከስባሄል ልጆች ኢያዳእያ፤
ከአረብያም ልጆች የአረብያ ልጅ አራድያ፥ አለቃው ኢያስያስ፤
ከኢስዓራውያን ሰሎሞት፤ ከሰሎሞት ልጆች ኤናት፤
ከኢዩዲዩ ልጆች አለቃው ይሪያ፥ ሁለተኛው አማርያ፥ ሦስተኛው ኢያዚሄል፥ አራተኛው ኢያቁምያ፤
የኢያዝሄል ልጅ ሚካ፤ የሚካ ልጅ ሳሜር፤
የሚካ ወንድም ኢሳእያ፤ የኢሳእያ ልጅ ዘካርያስ፤
የሜራሪ ልጆች ሞዓሊና ሐሙሲ፤ የዖዝያስ ልጅ ባኒ፤
የሜራሪ ልጆች፤ ከዖዝያ ይሰዓም፥ ዝኩር፥ አብዲ፤
የሞዓሊ ልጅ አልዓዛር፥ እርሱም ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤
ከቂስ፤ የቂስ ልጅ አራሜሄል፤
The sons of Hamusi; Moab, Edar, and Iarimoth. These were as the children of their fathers, the Levites.

And these also were leaders before the king, in the days of David, and in the days of Zadok, and in the days of Abimelech, among the Levites and the priests, as great men, like their younger brethren, even as the sons of Aaron, they were appointed.

sections.title: The Psalms of the House of the Temple

verses.text: And David and the captains of the army, from the sons of Asaph, from Heman, and from Jeduthun, were appointed to minister with instruments of music, and they were to prophesy with their instruments according to the service of each day. This was the number of the men who did the work.
From the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah; these were the sons of Asaph who were the chief musicians of the king.
From the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattaniah; these six, along with their father Jeduthun, were appointed to praise the Lord in the song of thanksgiving.
From the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Gedoliah, Romanthezer, Joshbekashah, Mehalathai, Hothir, and Mahazioth;

All these were to lift up the horn before the Lord, and they were the sons of Heman who prophesied with the harp in the presence of the king. And the Lord gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

All these were to serve in the house of the Lord with cymbals and with harps, and they were to give thanks to the Lord along with their fathers as they offered praise before the king. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were to give thanks.
The number of the valiant men who were to give thanks to the Lord, along with their brethren, was two hundred and eighty-eight.
All were gathered together, both small and great, and they were to offer praise for their service, and they were pure and learned in their ministry.

The first offering was for the sons of Asaph, for Joseph and his brethren, and for their sons, for twelve in total; the second offering was for Gedaliah and his sons and his brethren, for twelve in total;
The third offering was for Zaccur and his sons, for his brethren, for twelve in total;
The fourth [gift] is for Leitzri, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
The fifth [gift] is for Nathanias, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens.
The sixth [gift] is for Buqia, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
The seventh [gift] is for Yisrael, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
The eighth [gift] is for Iyasiah, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
The ninth [gift] is for Matanias, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
The tenth [gift] is for Semai, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
The eleventh [gift] is for Azareel, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
The twelfth [gift] is for Isabiah, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
The thirteenth [gift] is for Subael, for his sons, for his brothers, for the two tens;
ዐሥራ አራተኛው ለማታትያስ ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
ዐሥራ አምስተኛው ለኢየሪሙት ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
ዐሥራ ስድስተኛው ለሐናንያ ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
ዐሥራ ሰባተኛው ለዮስባቃጥ ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
ዐሥራ ስምንተኛው ለሐናኒ ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
ዐሥራ ዘጠነኛው ለማኤላቲ ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
ሃያኛው ለኤልያታ ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
