ሃያ አንደኛው ለኦትሪ ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
ሃያ ሁለተኛው ለጌዶላቲ ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
ሃያ ሦስተኛው ለመሐዝዮት ለልጆቹም፥ ለወንድሞቹም፥ ለዐሥራ ሁለቱ፤
The one hundred and forty-four thousand were sealed from the tribes of the children of Israel, twelve thousand from each tribe.

sections.title: The house of the Lord is a refuge.

verses.text: በረኞችም እንደዚህ ተመደቡ፤ ከቆሬያውያን ከአሳፍ ልጆች የቆሬ ልጅ ሜሱላም።
ሜሱላምም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በኵሩ ዘካርያስ፥ ሁለተኛው ይዲኤል፥ ሦስተኛው ዘባድያ፥ አራተኛው የትንኤል፤
አምስተኛው ኤላም፥ ስድስተኛው ይሆሐናን፥ ሰባተኛው ኤሊሆዔናይ።
ዖቤድኤዶምም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በኵሩ ሰማያ፥ ሁለተኛው ዮዛባት፥ ሦስተኛው ኢዮአስ፥ አራተኛው ሣካር፥ አምስተኛው ናትናኤል፤
ስድስተኛው ዓሚኤል፥ ሰባተኛው ይሳኮር፥ ስምንተኛው ፒላቲ ነበሩ፤ አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር ባርኮታልና።
ለልጁ ለሰማያም ከበኵር ልጁ ከሮሲ ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ እነርሱም በአባታቸው ቤት የሠለጠኑ እጅግም ኀያላን ነበሩ።
የሰማያ ልጆች ዖትኒ፥ ራፋኤል፥ ዖቤድ፥ ወንድሞቹም ኀያላን የነበሩ ኤልዛባድ፥ ኤሊሁ፥ ሰማክያ፥ ኢስባኮም።
እነዚህ ሁሉ የዖቤድኤዶም ልጆች ነበሩ፤ እነርሱም፥ ልጆቻቸውም፥ ወንድሞቻቸውም ለማገልገል ኀያላን የነበሩ የዖቤድኤዶም ልጆች ስድሳ ሁለት ነበሩ።
ለሜሱላምም ኀያላን የነበሩ ዐሥራ ስምንት ልጆችና ወንድሞች ነበሩት።
ከሜራሪም ልጆች ለነበረው ለሖሳ ፊተኛውን በር የሚጠብቁ ልጆች ነበሩት፤ አለቃውም ሰምሪ ነበረ፤ በኵር አልነበረም፤ አባቱ ግን አለቃ አደረገው፤
And the second was Chelkiah, and the third was Abdeel, and the fourth was Zechariah; all the sons and brothers of Hosha numbered thirty and three.
As their brethren, they served in the house of the Lord, and these were the keepers of the gates, who were appointed to guard each week.
And they served at every gate, according to the houses of their fathers, and they were small and great, and they were appointed to keep watch.
And the gate of the east was shut for Shelemiah and for Zechariah. And the sons of Joash brought forth the fire offering for Melchiah; and the offering went out towards the north.
For Abdidom, towards the south, beside the house of the vessels, the offering went out.
For the keepers of the west and for Hosha, towards the west, at the gate of the entrance, there was an offering upon offering.
In the east, there were six for each day; in the north, there were four for each day; in the south, there were four for each day; and for the house of the vessels, there were two for each day.

In the west, at the gate of the entrance, there were three; in the east, at the entrance, above the watch, there were six for each day; in the north, there were four; in the south, there were four; and for the house of the vessels, there were two for each day; in the west, there were four, and at the passageway, there were two for each day.
From the sons of Kohath and from the sons of Merari, these were the keepers of the gates.
And their brethren, the Levites, were in the house of the Lord, in the houses of assembly and in the holy places, and they were gathered together.
የለአዳን ልጆች፤ ለለአዳን የሆኑ የጌድሶናውያን ልጆች፥ ለጌድሶናዊው ለለአዳን የሆኑ፥ የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ይሔኤሊ፤
የይሔኤሊ ልጆች፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የነበሩ ዜቶም፥ ወንድሙም ኢዮኤል ነበረ።
ከእንበረማውያን፥ ከይስዓራውያን፥ ከኬብሮናውያን፥ ከዑዝኤላውያን፤
የሙሴ ልጅ የጌርሳም ልጅ ሱባኤል በቤተ መዛግብት ላይ ተሾሞ ነበር።
ወንድሞቹም፤ ከአልዓዛር ልጁ ረዓብያ፥ ልጁም የሳያ፥ ልጁም ኢዮራም፥ ልጁም ዝክሪ፥ ልጁም ሰሎሚት ነበሩ።
ይህ ሰሎሚትና ወንድሞቹ፥ ንጉሡ ዳዊትና የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ሻለቆችና የመቶ አለቆች፥ የሠራዊቱም አለቆች፥ በቀደሱት በንዋየ ቅድሳቱ ቤተ መዛግብት ሁሉ ላይ ተሹመው ነበር።
የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ሕንጻ ወደ ኋላ እንዳይል ዳዊት ከየሀገሩ በማረካቸውና በሰበሰባቸው በቀደሳቸውም ላይ የተሾሙ ናቸው።
ነቢዩ ሳሙኤል፥ የቂስም ልጅ ሳኦል፥ የኔርም ልጅ አበኔር፥ የሶርህያም ልጅ ኢዮአብ የቀደሱት የእግዚአብሔር ንዋየ ቅድሳት ሁሉ ከሰሎሚትና ከወንድሞቹ እጅ በታች ነበረ።
ከይሰዓራውያን ከናንያና ልጆቹ ጻፎችና ፈራጆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ በውጭው ሥራ በእስራኤል ላይ ተሾመው ነበር።
ከኬብሮናውያን ሐሳብያና ወንድሞቹ፥ ጽኑዓን የነበሩት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሰዎች፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ሁሉ፥ ለንጉሡም አገልግሎት በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምዕራብ በኩል ባለው በእስራኤል ላይ ተሾመው ነበር።

And among the sons of Kebron, there was a chief named Erias, who was of the lineage of the fathers. David sought for them in the fortieth year; and among them were found valiant men of great strength, mighty men of valor, from the sons of Gilead.

And the brethren, who were valiant, were two thousand seven hundred chief men of the houses of their fathers. And the king, David, acted according to the word of the Lord in all things, and according to the command of the king, he appointed them over the Reubenites and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and they made them shepherds over their flocks.

And the children of Israel were leaders of the houses of their fathers, and leaders of thousands, and leaders of hundreds, who served the king and obeyed all his commands; these were numbered according to their divisions. And these divisions were each twenty-four thousand, and they entered and departed each month of the year.
In the first month, in the first division, there was Abijah the son of Zephaniah; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
He was of the sons of Pharez; and in the first month, he was assigned over all the divisions of the twenty-four thousand.
In the second month, in the second division, there was Dodai the son of Ahoh; and in his division was Mikloth the leader; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
In the third month, the third leader of the division was Ahijah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
This was in the midst of the thirtieth, strong among the thirtieth; and in his division was his son Abimelech.
In the fourth month, the fourth leader of the division was Asahel the brother of Joab; and after him were his sons Zebadiah and his brothers; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
In the fifth month, the fifth leader of the division was Izrahiah the son of Shemaiah; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
In the sixth month, the sixth leader of the division was Jeziel the son of Abijah; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
In the seventh month, the seventh leader of the division was Helez of the children of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
በስምንተኛው ወር ስምንተኛው አለቃ ከዛራውያን የነበረው ኩሳታዊው ሲቦካይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሃያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።
በዘጠነኛው ወር ዘጠነኛው አለቃ ከብንያማውያን የነበረው ዓናቶታዊው አቢዔዜር ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሃያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።
በዐሥረኛው ወር ዐሥረኛው አለቃ ከዛራውያን የነበረው ነጦፋዊው መዐርኢ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሃያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።
በዐሥራ አንደኛው ወር ዐሥራ አንደኛው አለቃ ከኤፍሬም ልጆች የነበረው ፍርዓቶናዊው በናያስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሃያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።
በዐሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር ዐሥራ ሁለተኛው አለቃ ከጎቶንያል ወገን የነበረው ነጦፋታዊው ኬልዳይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሃያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።
በእስራኤልም ነገዶች ላይ እነዚህ ነበሩ፦ በሮቤላውያን ላይ የዝክሪ ልጅ ኤልያዛር አለቃ ነበረ፤ በስምዖናውያን ልጅ የመዓካ ልጅ ሰፋጥያስ ነበረ፤
በሌዊ ወገን ላይ የቀሙኤል ልጅ አሰብያ፤ በአሮን ወገን ላይ ሳዶቅ፤
በይሁዳ ወገን ላይ ከዳዊት ወንድሞች ኤልያብ፤ በይሳኮር ወገን ላይ የሚካኤል ልጅ ዖምሪ፤
በዛብሎን ወገን ላይ የአብድዩ ልጅ ሶማዒያስ፤ በንፍታሌም ወገን ላይ የዖዜሄል ልጅ ኢያሪሙት፤
በኤፍሬም ልጆች ላይ የአዛዝያ ልጅ ሆሴዕ፤ በምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ላይ የፈዳያ ልጅ ኢዩኤል፤
በገለዓድ ምድር ባለው በምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ላይ የዘብድያስ ልጅ ኢዮዳኢ፤ በብንያምም ልጆች ላይ የአበኔር ልጅ አሳሄል፤
በዳን ወገንም ላይ የኢዮራም ልጅ ዓዛርኤል፤ እነዚህ የእስራኤል ነገዶች አለቆች ነበሩ።
ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡ እስራኤልን እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት ያበዛ ዘንድ ተናግሮ ነበርና ዳዊት ከሃያ ዓመት በታች የነበሩትን አልቈጠረም።
የሶርህያ ልጅ ኢዮአብም መቍጠር ጀመረ፤ ነገር ግን አልፈጸመም፤ ስለዚህ ነገር በእስራኤል ላይ ቍጣ ሆነ፤ ቍጥራቸውም በንጉሡ በዳዊት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ አልተጻፈም።
በንጉሡም ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የዓዳኤል ልጅ ዓዝሞት ሹም ነበረ፤ በሜዳውም፥ በከተሞቹም፥ በመንደሮቹም፥ በግንቦቹም ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የዖዝያ ልጅ ዮናታን ሹም ነበረ፤
መሬቱን በሚያበጃጁትና እርሻውን በሚያርሱት ላይ የክሉብ ልጅ ዔዝሪ ሹም ነበረ፤
በወይንም ቦታዎች ላይ ራማታዊው ሰሜኢ ሹም ነበረ፤ ለወይንም ጠጅ ዕቃ ቤት በሚሆነው በወይኑ ሰብል ላይ የሳፍኒው ዘብዲ ሹም ነበረ።
በቈላውም ውስጥ ባሉት በወይራውና በሾላው ዛፎች ላይ ጌድራዊው በአልሐናን ሹም ነበረ፤ በዘይቱም ቤቶች ላይ ኢዮአስ ሹም ነበረ፤
በሳሮንም በሚሰማሩ ከብቶች ላይ ሳሮናዊው ሰጥራይ ሹም ነበረ፤ በሸለቆዎቹም ውስጥ በነበሩት ከብቶች ላይ የዓድላይ ልጅ ሳፋጥ ሹም ነበረ፤
በግመሎቹም ላይ እስማኤላዊው ኤቢያስ ሹም ነበረ፤ በአህዮቹም ላይ ሜሮኖታዊው ኢያድስ ሹም ነበረ፤
And upon the sheep was a shepherd who was a good man. All these were shepherds over the wealth of the king, over David.
The wise and scribe who was of David's lineage through his father was Jonathan, who was a mediator; and the son of Ahimelech, Abiathar, was with the king's sons.
Ahithophel was the king's counselor. The Arkite Hushai was the king's most trusted friend.
Following Ahithophel were the sons of Benah, Joad, and Abiathar; and Joab was the commander of the king's army.

sections.title: David showed Solomon the example of the house of the Lord.

verses.text: And David gathered all the leaders of Israel, and the judges, and those who kept watch over the king in every place, and the captains, and the rulers of hundreds, and the rulers of fifties, and the mighty men, and all the valiant men to Jerusalem.

And the king stood in the assembly and said, “My brethren and my people, hear me; I had it in my heart to build a house for the Lord, for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for our God, and I made preparations for the work.”
But God said to me, ‘You are a man of war, and have shed much blood; you shall not build a house for My name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in My sight.’

Nevertheless, the Lord God of Israel chose me above all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever; for He has chosen Judah to be the ruler, and of the house of Judah, the house of my father, and among my father's sons He was pleased to make me king over all Israel.
And of all my sons, for the Lord has given me many sons, He has chosen my son Solomon to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
And He said to me, ‘Your son Solomon shall build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him to be My son, and I will be his father.’
If he is careful to observe My commandments and My judgments, as it is this day, then I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the congregation of the Lord, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God, that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance for your children after you forever.

“And you, my son Solomon, know the God of your father, and serve Him with a loyal heart and with a willing mind; for the Lord searches all hearts and understands all the intent of the thoughts. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will cast you off forever.”
Consider now, for the Lord has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary; be strong, and do it.”

And David gave to the house of the Lord, and to his own house, and to the house of the storehouse, and to the chambers and to the inner rooms, and to the place of the altar, a pattern for the work to his son Solomon.

Moreover, he gave to the house of the Lord the treasuries and to the surrounding chambers, and for the house of the Lord which would be, for the holy vessels which would be, he gave a pattern for all that would be done by the Spirit.

The portions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work that they would do in the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels that would be used in the house of the Lord, for every service that would be.
For the gold vessels, he gave gold by weight; for every service that would be, for the silver vessels, he gave silver by weight.

For the gold of the lamps and for the lampstands, he gave gold by the weight of each lampstand and for each lamp; for the silver of the lampstands, he gave silver by the weight of each lampstand and for each lamp.
Likewise, for the tables of showbread, he gave gold by the weight for each table; and for the silver tables, he gave silver for each table.
For the meat offerings and for the drink offerings, he gave pure gold; for the gold cups, he gave gold by the weight of each cup; for the silver cups, he gave silver by the weight of each cup.
For the altar of incense, he gave pure gold by weight; and he showed a pattern of the cherubim that overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
Knowledge was given as it was revealed to David for the house of the Lord, which was written in the law of the Lord, which he gave to his son Solomon.

And David said to his son Solomon, “Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord God, my God, is with you; He will not leave you nor forsake you until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord. Behold, the pattern of the house of the Lord, and the pattern of all its chambers, and of all its treasuries, and of all the work of the service of the house of the Lord.”

Behold, the divisions of the priests and the Levites, who are to serve in the house of the Lord, are established here; for every manner of service and work shall be performed with wisdom and by the willing heart of each individual. All the leaders and the people shall be gathered together and shall be commanded thus.

King David also said to all the assembly, “The Lord has chosen my son Solomon alone to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord, for he is yet a young man and tender. And the work is great, for this house is not for man, but for the Lord God.”

And I, according to all my ability, have provided for the house of my God, gold for the things of gold, silver for the things of silver, bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, wood for the things of wood, and onyx stones and stones to be set, glistening stones of various colors, and all manner of precious stones, and abundance of marble stones.

Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have of my own proper good, gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house.
The house of the Lord must be adorned with three thousand talents of gold from Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver.

To every workman that is skilled among you, I have given gold for the work of gold, and silver for the work of silver. Today, who among you is willing to consecrate himself to the service of the Lord?”
The leaders of the fathers’ houses, the leaders of the tribes of Israel, the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly.

For the work of the house of the Lord, five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand darics, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron were given.
And all the chief of the people gave willingly to the house of the Lord, to the treasury, and they gave it into the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
And the people rejoiced, for they had offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they had offered willingly to the Lord; and King David also rejoiced with great joy.

King David blessed the Lord before all the assembly; and he said, “Blessed are You, Lord God of Israel, our father, forever and ever. Yours, O Lord, is the greatness, the power, and the glory, the victory, and the majesty; for all that is in heaven and in earth is Yours. Yours is the kingdom, O Lord, and You are exalted as head above all.”

O Lord, all that is in heaven and on earth belongs to Thee; greatness and power, glory and victory, and majesty are Thine; for all that is in heaven and in earth is Thine; and all the kingdoms and the people shall tremble before Thee.

Dominion and honor are from Thee; O Lord, Thou dost possess all things; Thou art the Lord of all power; strength and might are in Thy hand; Thou art mighty; to make great and to give strength to all, the whole world is held in Thy hand.
Now therefore, our God, we beseech Thee; we offer unto Thee praise for Thy glorious name.
All is from Thee; and from Thy hand we have received, and what are we that we should be able to offer unto Thee? Who am I, and what is my people?
As our fathers were strangers, so we are before Thee; we are strangers and sojourners, and our days upon the earth are as a shadow; do not forsake us.
O Lord our God, for the house of Thy holy name, I have prepared this abundance; all is from Thy hand, and all is Thine.

My God, I know that Thou dost search the heart, and dost take delight in uprightness; as for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things; and now, I rejoice in the joy of Thy people, as I have offered willingly.
O Lord, God of our fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, keep this thought in the heart of Thy people forever, and prepare their hearts unto Thee.
To observe Thy commandments, to keep Thy testimonies, and to establish the house which I have prepared for my son Solomon, grant him a perfect heart.
And David said to all the assembly, "Bless the Lord your God," and all the assembly blessed the Lord God of their fathers; and they bowed down their heads and worshipped the Lord and the king.

And in the evening, David offered sacrifices to the Lord; and he also presented the sacrifices that were to be offered to the Lord: one thousand burnt offerings, one thousand fattened rams, and one thousand lambs, along with their drink offerings; thus he offered many sacrifices for all of Israel.

And on that day, with great joy, they rejoiced before the Lord, and they drank. They proclaimed again concerning David's son Solomon; and they anointed him to be king before the Lord, and Zadok was anointed as high priest.
And Solomon sat upon the throne of his father David; and he was beloved in all respects; and all Israel obeyed him.
And all the leaders, the mighty men, and all the sons of King David submitted themselves to King Solomon.
And the Lord greatly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel; and he bestowed upon him a royal majesty that was not given to any of the kings that were before him.
The son of Jesse, David, reigned over all Israel for forty years.
Seven years he reigned in Hebron, and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
And in his old age, with riches and honor, he passed away; and his son Solomon reigned in his stead.
And concerning the matters of the king, and all that transpired, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer.
Likewise, the matters of the kingdom and all its might, and all that transpired in Israel, and among all the kingdoms of the earth, are recorded in the annals of those days.
